Lean and efficient — long legs, minimal upper-body bulk, and a frame optimized for covering distance. Every ounce serves forward motion.

A visual choice for your character's portrait — does not affect gameplay.

Starian.name: Starian
Starian.description:
the dominant species of Nexara. Starians are human-passing in appearance but possess innate flight and the potential for an affinity expression — a personal connection to a physical or perceptual force.

Your affinity is selected separately; not every Starian manifests one. Culture, upbringing and faction are independent choices that shape who you are beyond biology.

💡 Suggested aptitudes: Strength, Endurance.
Starian.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Starian. Fully human-passing adult with HUMAN ears — never pointed, never elfin, never elongated. Natural human skin tones only (no blue, grey, green or metallic skin). Hair and eye colours may include vivid multi-toned hues as normal Starian biology (not dye or contacts). Proportions, bone structure and facial features read as a real person; no anime-exaggerated or fantasy-elf traits. Flight is biological and invisible at rest; the back and shoulders are an ordinary person's, with nothing attached.

Full Starian biology, including innate flight; selected affinity is individual. Your foundational culture, upbringing and present affiliation are separate. Suggested aptitudes: Strength, Endurance. An explicitly chosen alternative pair replaces these two points; it does not add points. For an explicit alternative use exactly [Creator aptitude] Starian / <first>,<second>, in attribute order strength,agility,endurance,intellect,awareness,resolve,presence,charisma. Only a defined trait may be assigned.

Fly using ordinary Starian biology: take off, hover, travel through open air and land within your actual health, load, stamina, space and proficiency. Every healthy Starian has this capability, including affinityless and unpracticed Starians. It does not require magic, wings, a device, an affinity, a skill purchase or a dramatic awakening. Training improves handling and endurance; it does not grant permission to fly. Injury and real limitations can impair use; carrying someone requires safe handling and adequate capacity. Ordinary local takeoffs and landings are routine, not shocking or evidence of exceptional power.

Human.name: Human
Human.description:
arrived on Nexara from Terra (Earth) or other settled worlds. Humans have no species-exclusive powers but are widely adaptable and socially versatile.

Humans are a visible minority on Nexara — recognised, sometimes underestimated, and navigating a society that wasn't built for them. Your origin, upbringing and faction shape how you fit in.

💡 Suggested aptitudes: Awareness, Charisma.
Human.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Human. Ordinary human adult with completely standard human anatomy, human ears, human skin tones, human hair and eye colours. No alien features, no pointed ears, no unusual skin colours. Clothing is contemporary science-fiction civilian — advanced fabrics and clean construction, never Earth brand logos, denim jeans, baseball caps or recognisable Earth fashion. On Nexara, Humans are visibly foreign: their gear looks imported and practical rather than locally styled.

No species-exclusive power is created. Your foundational culture, upbringing and present affiliation are separate. Suggested aptitudes: Awareness, Charisma. An explicitly chosen alternative pair replaces these two points; it does not add points. For an explicit alternative use exactly [Creator aptitude] Human / <first>,<second>, in attribute order strength,agility,endurance,intellect,awareness,resolve,presence,charisma. Only a defined trait may be assigned.

Kharai.name: Kharai
Kharai.description:
a feline-featured species with two distinct lineages. Terran Kharai are humanoid with cat ears, tail and feline eyes. Xeon Kharai are fully bipedal felines with complete fur and animal features.

Your lineage is determined by your Origin trait. Kharai retain their lineage's senses and bodily capabilities — enhanced hearing, low-light vision and agility — but are bound by the same physical limits as anyone their size.

💡 Suggested aptitudes: Agility, Awareness.
Kharai.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Kharai. Lineage determines body plan — see Origin trait for Terran or Xeon line. If no Origin selected: default to Terran lineage. Terran Kharai: humanoid frame with genuine feline ears set HIGH on the skull (not human ear position), functional feline tail, feline eyes with vertical-slit pupils and visible reflective tapetum lucidum, fine velvety facial fur over real bone structure. Xeon Kharai: fully bipedal feline — complete fur covering, animal-shaped muzzle with whiskers, digitigrade legs, feline paw-hands with padding, full feline tail. NEVER catgirl, never anime cat-ear headband, never mascot, never pet. Real feline anatomy rendered with physical weight and presence.

Your lineage is determined by your Origin trait. Rivani are typically smaller in stature with excellent fine motor control, making them natural craftspeople and assemblers.

💡 Suggested aptitudes: Agility, Awareness.

Terran Rivani: humanoid frame with genuine rounded rodent ears (large, mobile, thin-skinned, set high), functional balancing tail, large dark expressive eyes with visible sclera, slightly compact stature. Xeon Rivani: fully bipedal rodent — complete fur covering, animal-shaped muzzle with whiskers and prominent incisors, rounded mobile ears, prehensile tail, digitigrade or plantigrade hind feet. Olyth.description:
an adaptive living-matter species that maintains a stable bipedal form. Olyth can reshape their body within limits set by their mass and core pattern — they are not shapeshifters but can adjust proportions, surface texture and features over time.

Internal luminous cores are visible beneath semi-translucent skin. Each Olyth's surface ranges from translucent to opaque to metallic depending on the individual.

Castro.name: Castro
Castro.description:
Solvraxis. The dominant House on Nexara, built around restraint, protection and personal sovereignty. Castro's power comes from reputation and the conviction that strength should protect freedom, not impose order. Castro is the ideological opposite of Dravon.

This is your formative House, not your current affiliation. No automatic rank, employment or private access.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Resolve, +1 Presence, +5 Concentration.
Castro.traitNarrativeEffects: House Castro formative training emphasises self-control, measured response and protective action. The character defaults to restraint under pressure and distrusts imposed authority. They carry Castro values — freedom, personal sovereignty, responsibility — as instinct, not ideology. Present situations where restraint is tested, where power could be used but probably should not be. Explicit alternatives: presence; Escorting => [Creator culture] Castro / presence / K160; presence; Mediation => [Creator culture] Castro / presence / K039; awareness; Concentration => [Creator culture] Castro / awareness / K011; awareness; Escorting => [Creator culture] Castro / awareness / K160; awareness; Mediation => [Creator culture] Castro / awareness / K039. Genesis.name: Genesis
Genesis.description:
Korrvane. The second most powerful House, built around overwhelming physical presence, challenge culture and direct competition. Genesis values strength, loyalty and blunt honesty. Their Arena and Ladder culture defines Korrvane's identity.

This is your formative House, not your current affiliation. No automatic rank, employment or private access.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Endurance, +1 Strength, +5 Striking.
Genesis.traitNarrativeEffects: House Genesis formative training emphasises physical conditioning, direct challenge and endurance under pressure. The character respects visible strength, expects straightforward communication and instinctively sizes up physical competition. Present physical challenges, competitive situations and moments where directness matters more than diplomacy. Explicit alternatives: strength; Running => [Creator culture] Genesis / strength / K002; strength; Leadership => [Creator culture] Genesis / strength / K032; presence; Striking => [Creator culture] Genesis / presence / K149; presence; Running => [Creator culture] Genesis / presence / K002; presence; Leadership => [Creator culture] Genesis / presence / K032. Dravon.name: Dravon
Dravon.description:
Quilrath. The primary destabilising threat on Nexara, built around control, classification and imposed hierarchy. Dravon rules through a grading system, surveillance and the belief that strength should create order. Permanently barred from Contair support.

This is your formative House, not your current affiliation. No automatic rank, employment or private access.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Resolve, +1 Presence, +5 Tactics.
Dravon.traitNarrativeEffects: House Dravon formative training emphasises discipline, obedience to structure and tactical awareness. The character is accustomed to hierarchical thinking, classification systems and the expectation that authority should be obeyed. Present situations where imposed order conflicts with individual freedom, and moments where discipline is an asset or a cage. Explicit alternatives: presence; Blocking => [Creator culture] Dravon / presence / K159; presence; Administration => [Creator culture] Dravon / presence / K131; strength; Tactics => [Creator culture] Dravon / strength / K161; strength; Blocking => [Creator culture] Dravon / strength / K159; strength; Administration => [Creator culture] Dravon / strength / K131. Contair.name: Contair
Contair.description:
Vexorath. Nexara's invention and infrastructure House, maintaining the gate network and rejecting House-dominance politics. Contair values practical invention, engineering and independence — building what works without claiming political power.

No restricted designs are granted. This is your formative House, not your current affiliation. No automatic rank, employment or private access.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Intellect, +1 Agility, +5 Assembly.
Contair.traitNarrativeEffects: House Contair formative training emphasises practical problem-solving, mechanical skill and intellectual curiosity. 📊 Default bonuses: +1 Charisma, +1 Resolve, +5 Teaching.
Bloom.traitNarrativeEffects: Bloom formative background means growing up within the Elyri Attunement of birth and mentorship. The character is a natural teacher, values the formation of new consciousness and carries the responsibility of guiding those who are just beginning to exist. Present situations involving teaching, nurturing and the profound questions around Elyri creation. Explicit alternatives: resolve; Counseling => [Creator culture] Bloom / resolve / K035; resolve; First Aid => [Creator culture] Bloom / resolve / K096; awareness; Teaching => [Creator culture] Bloom / awareness / K034; awareness; Counseling => [Creator culture] Bloom / awareness / K035; awareness; First Aid => [Creator culture] Bloom / awareness / K096. At most one, before floor settlement.

Blaze.name: Blaze
Blaze.description:
an Elyri Attunement of Aethrys focused on defence and intensity. The Attunement that answers what happens when beings of living energy must fight. Small, disciplined, and treated with the respect given to a necessary capability.

This is your formative background, not your current affiliation. No automatic rank, employment or private access.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Resolve, +1 Presence, +5 Escorting.
Blaze.traitNarrativeEffects: Blaze formative background means growing up within the Elyri Attunement of defence and martial intensity. The character understands controlled force, respects the weight of violence in a species that exists as living energy, and carries the discipline of those trained to protect. Present situations involving defence, escorting and the moral weight of fighting as an energy being. Explicit alternatives: presence; Tactics => [Creator culture] Blaze / presence / K161; presence; Concentration => [Creator culture] Blaze / presence / K011; awareness; Escorting => [Creator culture] Blaze / awareness / K160; awareness; Tactics => [Creator culture] Blaze / awareness / K161; awareness; Concentration => [Creator culture] Blaze / awareness / K011. At most one, before floor settlement.

Teenager.name: Teenager
Teenager.description:
the youngest playable life stage. Your character is still growing into who they will become: apprenticed, enrolled or under guardianship rather than working independently.

NPCs may be protective, dismissive or cautious about involving you in dangerous work. Age-gated venues, curfews and legal restrictions apply. You carry fewer obligations but also less authority.

Include a species-appropriate age in your background.
Teenager.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is treated as a minor or near-minor by the cultures around them. Adults may be protective, dismissive or cautious about involving them in dangerous work. Curfews, age-gated venues and legal restrictions apply. They lack independent legal standing in most jurisdictions and need a guardian's consent for contracts, travel permits and medical decisions. Physical capabilities are still developing — full adult stamina, strength and reflexes are not yet reached. Social standing comes from family or institution, not personal reputation.

Young adult.name: Young adult
Young adult.description:
early independence. Your character has recently come of age and is establishing themselves: first postings, early career, new freedoms and the pressure that comes with them.

Elders and veterans may test or mentor you; peers compete for the same opportunities. You have legal independence but are still building the reputation and experience that earn trust.

Include a species-appropriate age in your background.
Young adult.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is recognised as a legal adult but is still building reputation and experience. Elders and veterans may test or mentor them; peers compete for the same opportunities. They carry the energy and resilience of youth but lack the network, standing and institutional memory that come with years. First mistakes are more easily forgiven but also more closely watched. Physical capabilities are at or near peak.

Adult.name: Adult
Adult.description:
the broadest life stage. Your character is settled into their skills, responsibilities and social position: experienced enough to be trusted with serious work, young enough to still be in the thick of events.

You are expected to handle your own affairs, honour obligations and answer for your choices. Professional standing, family ties and reputation all carry weight.

Include a species-appropriate age in your background.
Adult.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is treated as a full, competent participant in society. They are expected to handle their own affairs, honour obligations and answer for their choices. Professional standing, family ties and personal reputation carry real weight in how others respond to them. Physical capabilities are reliable and consistent. They have enough experience to recognise familiar situations but enough future to invest in long-term plans.

Older adult.name: Older adult
Older adult.description:
the later years. Your character carries the weight of a long life: hard-won expertise, old alliances, old grudges and the respect or suspicion that comes with a name people remember.

Younger people may defer, seek counsel or underestimate you depending on context. Long experience lends authority in familiar domains but the world keeps changing around you.

Include a species-appropriate age in your background.
Older adult.traitNarrativeEffects: The character's age is visible and culturally noted. Younger people may defer, seek counsel or underestimate them depending on context. Long experience lends authority in familiar domains but the world keeps changing. Physical endurance and recovery are declining, though skill and judgement may compensate. They carry a lifetime of relationships — allies, rivals, debts and obligations — that shape how institutions and individuals respond to them. Retirement, legacy and succession are live concerns.

Unexpressed.name: Unexpressed
Unexpressed.description:
Your Starian biology carries the potential for affinity, but it has never surfaced. You have no trained control and no starting technique.

This is not a limitation — many Starians live full lives without expressing. Your affinity may emerge later through stress, discovery, or simply time, or it may remain dormant. Choose this if you want your power's awakening to be part of your story.
Unexpressed.traitNarrativeEffects: Unexpressed Starian affinity. The character has biological potential but no manifested expression. Preserve the distinction between unexpressed, weak, concealed, and undecided — these are different states with different narrative meaning. No practiced control floor or starting technique is granted. Emergence during play should feel organic and earned, never instantaneous mastery. An unexpressed Starian is not powerless — they have their full species capabilities, training, and occupation.

Weak expression.name: Weak expression
Weak expression.description:
Your affinity exists but manifests faintly — inconsistent flickers rather than reliable control. You have no trained technique.

A weak expression can still surprise you in moments of need or emotion. Choose this if you want an affinity that's present but unreliable, something to grow into rather than depend on.
Weak expression.traitNarrativeEffects: Weak expression Starian affinity. The character's power manifests intermittently and without precision. Preserve the distinction between unexpressed, weak, concealed, and undecided. Weak expression may flicker under stress or emotion but cannot be called on demand with consistent results. No practiced control floor or starting technique is granted. Growth is possible through training and experience, but the starting state is genuinely limited, not secretly powerful.

Hidden expression.name: Hidden expression
Hidden expression.description:
Your affinity is real and present, but you have learned to conceal it — from others, from institutions, perhaps from yourself. You have no trained technique.

A hidden expression might be suppressed for social, political, or personal reasons. Choose this if the secret of your power matters more than its use.
Hidden expression.traitNarrativeEffects: Hidden expression Starian affinity. The character actively conceals a real, present affinity. The concealment has a reason — social pressure, political danger, personal trauma, deliberate strategy — and that reason should inform interactions. Preserve the distinction between unexpressed, weak, concealed, and undecided. No practiced control floor or starting technique is granted. Moments of accidental revelation carry real consequences.

Undecided expression.name: Undecided expression
Undecided expression.description:
Your affinity has surfaced but hasn't settled into a specific form. The potential is broad and unresolved — you feel something, but its nature remains open.

Choose this if you want the direction of your power to emerge through play rather than be decided at character creation.
Undecided expression.traitNarrativeEffects: Undecided expression Starian affinity. The character's affinity is active but unfocused, not yet committed to a specific expression. Preserve the distinction between unexpressed, weak, concealed, and undecided. The undecided state is genuine biological ambiguity, not access to every expression simultaneously. No practiced control floor or starting technique is granted. When the expression eventually resolves, it should feel like a discovery, shaped by the character's experiences and temperament.

No specialized embodiment practice.name: No specialized embodiment practice
No specialized embodiment practice.description:
You are Elyri — a living being of condensed energy, sustained by your aether core. You have not yet trained in a specialized embodiment practice, preserving your potential without committing to a path.

All Elyri carry their core capabilities: physical form, visible energy channels, light-formed eyes. A specialized practice focuses your embodiment into a particular discipline, but choosing none keeps your future open.
No specialized embodiment practice.traitNarrativeEffects: Elyri without specialized embodiment practice. Biology remains intact — aether core, energy channels, light-formed eyes, all species-standard capabilities. No trained control floor or authored technique is granted. The character's embodiment potential is genuine but undirected; specialization may emerge through play. Do not portray as weaker than other Elyri — unpracticed is not incapable.

No innate affinity selection.name: No innate affinity selection
No innate affinity selection.description:
Your species does not carry innate Starian affinity or Elyri embodiment. This is not a disadvantage — Humans, Kharai, Rivani, Olyth, and Zencadians each have their own strengths and capabilities.

Learned traditional magic remains available as a separate path, and your species' own traits define how you engage with the world.
No innate affinity selection.traitNarrativeEffects: The character's species has no innate affinity or embodiment. This is a biological fact, not a limitation to overcome through willpower. Learned traditional magic remains a separate eligible choice. The character's species-specific capabilities are their foundation — do not treat absence of affinity as absence of power.

They may recognise common magical effects from cultural familiarity but cannot replicate, analyse or counter them.

Illumination and signals.name: Illumination and signals
Illumination and signals.description:
you have prior instruction in creating and controlling light through magical workings. You can produce a steady held light, shape visible signals and perceive magical fields.

One starting discipline; advanced techniques are earned through play. ⚔️ Starting technique: Held Lamp. 🎯 Skills: Lightcraft +10, Field Perception +5, Channeling +10.
Illumination and signals.traitNarrativeEffects: Prior supported instruction in Illumination and signals. The character can produce and sustain magical light, shape it into simple signals and perceive nearby magical fields. All workings require field dependence (a workable magical environment), actual prior instruction and metabolic cost. Advanced techniques — brighter light, shaped projections, diagnostic illumination — are earned through practice and teaching, not granted at creation.

Elemental workings — selected thermal tr.name: Elemental workings — selected thermal track
Elemental workings — selected thermal tr.description:
you have prior instruction in controlled thermal magic. You can produce a gentle warming working and perceive magical fields. Your specific thermal focus (heating, cooling or balanced) develops through play.

One starting discipline; advanced techniques are earned through play. ⚔️ Starting technique: Warming Working. 🎯 Skills: Thermal Magic +10, Field Perception +5, Channeling +10.
Elemental workings — selected thermal tr.traitNarrativeEffects: Prior supported instruction in elemental thermal workings. The character can produce controlled thermal effects — currently limited to gentle warming. All workings require field dependence, prior instruction and metabolic cost. Advanced techniques — stronger heating, cooling, temperature regulation, thermal shielding — are earned through practice and teaching. The specific thermal specialisation develops through use.

Directed force.name: Directed force
Directed force.description:
you have prior instruction in applying physical force through magical workings. You can produce a gentle nudge effect and perceive magical fields.

One starting discipline; advanced techniques are earned through play. ⚔️ Starting technique: Force Nudge. 🎯 Skills: Forcecraft +10, Field Perception +5, Channeling +10.
Directed force.traitNarrativeEffects: Prior supported instruction in directed force. The character can apply a small, controlled magical push — enough to move a light object or deflect something gently. All workings require field dependence, prior instruction and metabolic cost. Advanced techniques — stronger force, sustained pressure, precise manipulation — are earned through practice and teaching.

Wards and protection.name: Wards and protection
Wards and protection.description:
you have prior instruction in creating magical barriers and protective inscriptions. You can set a small ward patch and perceive magical fields.

One starting discipline; advanced techniques are earned through play. ⚔️ Starting technique: Ward Patch. 🎯 Skills: Warding +10, Field Perception +5, Inscription +10.
Wards and protection.traitNarrativeEffects: Prior supported instruction in wards and protection. The character can create a small protective ward — a localised barrier that resists a specific type of intrusion. All workings require field dependence, prior instruction and metabolic cost. Advanced techniques — larger wards, stronger barriers, layered protections, alarm triggers — are earned through practice and teaching.

Binding and containment.name: Binding and containment
Binding and containment.description:
you have prior instruction in magical restraint and containment workings. You can create a basic restraining loop and perceive magical fields.

One starting discipline; advanced techniques are earned through play. ⚔️ Starting technique: Restraining Loop. 🎯 Skills: Binding +10, Field Perception +5, Channeling +10.
Binding and containment.traitNarrativeEffects: Prior supported instruction in binding and containment. The character can create a basic magical restraint — a loop of force that holds a willing or unresisting target in place. All workings require field dependence, prior instruction and metabolic cost. Advanced techniques — stronger bindings, area containment, suppression fields — are earned through practice and teaching.

Detection and inspection.name: Detection and inspection
Detection and inspection.description:
you have prior instruction in using magic to detect, analyse and inspect objects, fields and workings. You can perform a basic working read and perceive magical fields with enhanced clarity.

One starting discipline; advanced techniques are earned through play. ⚔️ Starting technique: Working Read. 🎯 Skills: Arcane Detection +10, Field Perception +10.
Detection and inspection.traitNarrativeEffects: Prior supported instruction in detection and inspection. The character can read the basic state of a magical working or enchanted object — is it active, stable, damaged or failing. All workings require field dependence and prior instruction. Advanced techniques — deeper analysis, remote detection, working identification — are earned through practice and teaching.

Preservation and conditioning.name: Preservation and conditioning
Preservation and conditioning.description:
you have prior instruction in magical techniques that preserve materials, slow decay and maintain conditions. You can apply a basic keeping seal and perceive magical fields.

One starting discipline; advanced techniques are earned through play. ⚔️ Starting technique: Keeping Seal. 🎯 Skills: Arcane Preservation +10, Field Perception +5, Inscription +10.
Preservation and conditioning.traitNarrativeEffects: Prior supported instruction in preservation and conditioning. The character can apply a basic magical seal that slows decay in a small container or surface area. All workings require field dependence, prior instruction and metabolic cost. Advanced techniques — larger areas, stronger preservation, environmental conditioning, material stabilisation — are earned through practice and teaching.

Healing and stabilization.name: Healing and stabilization
Healing and stabilization.description:
you have prior instruction in magical techniques that support biological recovery and stabilise injuries. You can perform a basic stabilising working and perceive magical fields.

One starting discipline; advanced techniques are earned through play. ⚔️ Starting technique: Stabilizing Working. 🎯 Skills: Arcane Healing +10, Field Perception +5, Channeling +10.
Healing and stabilization.traitNarrativeEffects: Prior supported instruction in healing and stabilisation. The character can apply a basic magical stabilisation — slowing bleeding, reducing inflammation or supporting a body's natural recovery processes. This is first aid, not surgery. All workings require field dependence, prior instruction and metabolic cost. Advanced techniques — deeper healing, bone setting, toxin neutralisation — are earned through practice and teaching.

Route marks and movement assistance.name: Route marks and movement assistance
Route marks and movement assistance.description:
you have prior instruction in magical techniques for navigation, marking routes and assisting movement through inscribed workings.

One starting discipline; advanced techniques are earned through play. ⚔️ Starting technique: Route Sign. 🎯 Skills: Route Marking +10, Field Perception +5, Inscription +10, Invocation +5.
Route marks and movement assistance.traitNarrativeEffects: Prior supported instruction in route marks and movement assistance. The character can inscribe a basic route sign — a magical marker visible to those who know what to look for, useful for navigation and path-finding. All workings require field dependence, prior instruction and metabolic cost. Advanced techniques — persistent markers, movement-assisting workings, terrain adaptation — are earned through practice and teaching.

Authentication and working upkeep.name: Authentication and working upkeep
Authentication and working upkeep.description:
you have prior instruction in verifying magical seals, maintaining existing workings and inspecting magical infrastructure for integrity.

One starting discipline; advanced techniques are earned through play. ⚔️ Starting technique: Seal Check. 🎯 Skills: Sealcraft +10, Field Perception +5, Arcane Inspection +10.
Authentication and working upkeep.traitNarrativeEffects: Prior supported instruction in authentication and working upkeep. The character can check the integrity of a magical seal — verifying whether it is genuine, intact and functioning as intended. All workings require field dependence and prior instruction. Advanced techniques — complex authentication, working repair, infrastructure maintenance — are earned through practice and teaching.

No formal style.name: No formal style
No formal style.description:
you have no trained combat discipline. You can still defend yourself using instinct and improvisation, but you lack the drilled techniques that trained fighters rely on.

Available to all species and cultures. No trained skill floors, starting actions or weapon classes are granted. You can pursue training later through play.
No formal style.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has no formal combat training. They react to threats with instinct, improvisation and whatever is at hand. They lack trained muscle memory, defensive stances and the automatic responses that come from drilling. Against a trained opponent, they are at a significant disadvantage in sustained exchanges. They can still be dangerous — desperation and unpredictability have their own value — but they tire quickly and make mistakes under pressure.

Basic unarmed defense.name: Basic unarmed defense
Basic unarmed defense.description:
personal or civic self-defence instruction. You have learned a basic fighting stance, how to maintain distance and a measured defensive response to protect yourself when threatened.

Available to all species with learned bodily practice. ⚔️ Starting action: Guarded Defense. 🎯 Skills: Striking +15, Dodging +10.
Basic unarmed defense.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in basic unarmed defense. The character can adopt a learned defensive stance, maintain distance from a threat and execute a measured defensive movement. Their training is defensive — they protect themselves and create space to withdraw, not to dominate. Against an armed opponent or a more skilled fighter, their best option is still to disengage. The training is physical habit, not theoretical knowledge — it works under stress but has clear limits.

Grappling fundamentals.name: Grappling fundamentals
Grappling fundamentals.description:
trained holds, escapes and controlled contact. You can attempt a grapple using actual leverage and technique, but controlling a stronger or larger body is never guaranteed.

Requires compatible anatomy and instruction. ⚔️ Starting action: Controlled Grapple. 🎯 Skills: Grappling +15, Blocking +10.
Grappling fundamentals.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in grappling fundamentals. The character can attempt trained holds, escapes and takedowns using leverage and body positioning. Success depends on relative size, strength and anatomy — controlling a significantly stronger or larger opponent requires favourable circumstances. The training includes breakfall techniques and awareness of how to protect joints during ground contact.

Staff fundamentals.name: Staff fundamentals
Staff fundamentals.description:
trained staff technique for distance management, blocking and controlled strikes. You need an actually held staff to use these techniques; local possession and carry rules still apply.

Available to all species with actual instruction. ⚔️ Starting action: Staff Guard. 🎯 Skills: Staff Fighting +15, Blocking +10.
Staff fundamentals.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in staff fundamentals. The character uses a held staff to manage distance, block incoming attacks and redirect an opponent's momentum. The staff extends reach and provides a strong defensive barrier. Technique requires the actual weapon in hand — without it, the training's value drops to footwork and distance awareness only.

Common blade fundamentals.name: Common blade fundamentals
Common blade fundamentals.description:
trained technique with a familiar edged weapon. You can maintain distance, execute controlled exchanges and defend yourself with a blade you know.

Available to all species with actual instruction. No named House tradition is granted. ⚔️ Starting action: Measured Blade Exchange. 🎯 Skills: Swordsmanship +15, Dodging +10. 🎒 Starts with: Ordinary personal blade.
Common blade fundamentals.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in common blade fundamentals. The character can fight with a familiar blade — maintaining distance, timing exchanges and defending against incoming attacks. Their technique is functional and disciplined but lacks the distinctive style of a House tradition. They need their actual weapon in hand; an unfamiliar blade of different weight or balance degrades their performance.

Firearm fundamentals.name: Firearm fundamentals
Firearm fundamentals.description:
trained marksmanship and weapon safety with a familiar firearm class. You can take deliberate, controlled shots after assessing the situation.

No permit is granted by this trait. ⚔️ Starting action: Controlled Shot. 🎯 Skills: Firearms +15, Inspection +10. 🎒 Starts with: Personal sidearm, Sidearm charge pack.
Firearm fundamentals.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in firearm fundamentals. The character can handle, maintain and fire a familiar weapon class with trained discipline — checking target, line of fire and surroundings before shooting. Their training emphasises safety and controlled fire, not rapid engagement. They inspect and maintain their weapon by habit. An unfamiliar weapon class requires retraining.

Protective escort fundamentals.name: Protective escort fundamentals
Protective escort fundamentals.description:
trained civilian protection techniques. You can coordinate a companion's withdrawal toward cover while maintaining situational awareness.

No badge, authority or command structure is granted. ⚔️ Starting action: Covering Withdrawal. 🎯 Skills: Escorting +15, Tactics +10.
Protective escort fundamentals.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in protective escort fundamentals. The character can guide a consenting person toward safety while maintaining awareness of threats. They know how to position themselves between a threat and a companion, identify actual cover, and coordinate movement under stress. Their training is protection-focused — they get people out, not in.

Castro / Valcoro restraint practice.name: Castro / Valcoro restraint practice
Castro / Valcoro restraint practice.description:
protection and restraint techniques from Castro or Valcoro formative training. You can attempt controlled restraint or separation with attention to the other person's wellbeing.

Requires Starian species + Castro or Valcoro background. ⚔️ Starting action: Measured Restraint. 🎯 Skills: Grappling +15, Escorting +10.
Castro / Valcoro restraint practice.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in Castro / Valcoro restraint practice. The character can attempt a learned protective restraint or separation, managing a person's movement while monitoring their breathing, joint stress and emotional state. The technique prioritises de-escalation and the restrained person's safety. It is not designed for combat dominance — against someone actively fighting, the holds are harder to maintain. This is the public shape of the Castro Form, taught by House Valcoro: control before force.

Genesis / Orvantis / Zelvaris pressure p.name: Genesis / Orvantis / Zelvaris pressure practice
Genesis / Orvantis / Zelvaris pressure p.description:
direct competitive physical practice from one of the listed formative cultures. You use footwork and measured bodily action to contest space.

Requires Starian species + one listed culture. ⚔️ Starting action: Controlled Forward Pressure. 🎯 Skills: Striking +15, Running +10.
Genesis / Orvantis / Zelvaris pressure p.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in competitive pressure practice. The character uses learned footwork and one measured bodily action to contest an opponent's space — closing distance, forcing a retreat or disrupting their balance. The style is direct and physically demanding, relying on conditioning and commitment rather than finesse. It is competitive in origin, drilled through structured bouts. This is the public shape of Genesis Open Form: strength is witnessed.

Dravon disciplined defense.name: Dravon disciplined defense
Dravon disciplined defense.description:
defensive position and tactical awareness from Dravon instruction. You maintain a disciplined guard, use terrain and awareness of nearby allies or exits to manage threats.

Requires Starian + Dravon background (or actual Dravon instruction for Nivarek/Balrath/Kathvar). ⚔️ Starting action: Disciplined Guard. 🎯 Skills: Blocking +15, Tactics +10.
Dravon disciplined defense.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in Dravon disciplined defense. The character maintains a learned defensive position, uses terrain features and tracks nearby allies or exits to manage an immediate threat. The style emphasises patience, position and coordinated awareness over individual aggression. They block, redirect and wait for a controlled opening rather than pressing the attack. This is the public shape of Dravon Redline: the formation is the weapon.

Corsair adaptive blade practice.name: Corsair adaptive blade practice
Corsair adaptive blade practice.description:
movement, timing and adaptation with a blade from Corsair formative training. You adjust angle and distance in response to a changing fight, emphasising mobility over committed attacks.

Requires Starian + Corsair background. ⚔️ Starting action: Adaptive Blade Step. 🎯 Skills: Swordsmanship +15, Dodging +10. 🎒 Starts with: Ordinary personal blade.
Corsair adaptive blade practice.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in Corsair adaptive blade practice. The character uses a held blade with emphasis on movement, timing and adaptation — changing angle and distance to keep an opponent off-balance. The style favours mobility and opportunism over committed exchanges. They are hard to pin down but may lack the stopping power of more aggressive traditions. This is the public shape of Corsair Wayline: the blade protects movement.

Veltrax pursuit blade practice.name: Veltrax pursuit blade practice
Veltrax pursuit blade practice.description:
forward pressure and pursuit with a blade from Veltrax formative training. You maintain controlled pressure as an opponent yields space, turning retreat into disadvantage.

Requires Starian + Veltrax background. ⚔️ Starting action: Pursuit Blade Step. 🎯 Skills: Swordsmanship +15, Running +10. 🎒 Starts with: Ordinary personal blade.
Veltrax pursuit blade practice.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in Veltrax pursuit blade practice. The character uses a held blade to maintain controlled forward pressure — closing distance when an opponent gives ground and turning their retreat into a positional disadvantage. The style is aggressive and physically demanding, relying on conditioning and footwork. They struggle when an opponent refuses to yield space. This is the public shape of Veltrax Redcourt: forward is also a defense.

Volen / Caldris protective practice.name: Volen / Caldris protective practice
Volen / Caldris protective practice.description:
defensive techniques from Volen or Caldris formative training, focused on placing yourself between a threat and someone or something you are protecting.

No heat immunity or fire affinity is granted. Requires Starian + Volen or Caldris background. ⚔️ Starting action: Protective Interposition. 🎯 Skills: Blocking +15, Escorting +10.
Volen / Caldris protective practice.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in Volen / Caldris protective practice. The character places their trained guard between a threat and a person or vulnerable point they are protecting. The style prioritises the protected target over personal safety — they absorb risk that would otherwise reach what is behind them. Effective against direct threats; less useful when the danger bypasses the guard position entirely. This is the public shape of Volen Crucible doctrine and Caldris wall-keeping.

Starian aerial engagement.name: Starian aerial engagement
Starian aerial engagement.description:
aerial combat practice using innate Starian flight. You can execute controlled manoeuvres, defensive turns and altitude changes in a fight, using your body's own flight as a trained instrument rather than raw instinct.

Requires Starian species with learned aerial practice. ⚔️ Starting action: Aerial Defensive Turn. 🎯 Skills: Starian Flight +15, Dodging +10.
Starian aerial engagement.traitNarrativeEffects: Actual prior training in Starian aerial engagement. The character uses ordinary Starian flight combined with drilled aerial technique — controlled direction changes, altitude shifts and defensive turns that use three-dimensional space to evade or reposition. The training builds on innate flight biology; at zero flight skill, it provides fundamentals rather than advanced manoeuvres. Effective in open spaces; confined environments severely limit aerial options.

Focus: Climbing.name: Focus: Climbing
Focus: Climbing.description: Trained to scale surfaces with proper grip and rope technique. Comfortable at height.

Focus: Running.name: Focus: Running
Focus: Running.description: Trained to sustain demanding pace over sprints and long distances. Manages footing and breath.

Focus: Swimming.name: Focus: Swimming
Focus: Swimming.description: Trained to propel and support the body through water. Handles current and temperature.

Focus: Hiking.name: Focus: Hiking
Focus: Hiking.description: Trained to pace sustained travel over difficult ground. Manages load, rest and footing.

Focus: Acrobatics.name: Focus: Acrobatics
Focus: Acrobatics.description: Trained in tumbling, vaults and controlled falls. Comfortable on narrow surfaces.

Focus: Stealth.name: Focus: Stealth
Focus: Stealth.description: Trained to move concealed using cover, light and timing. Manages noise and visibility.

Focus: Dodging.name: Focus: Dodging
Focus: Dodging.description: Trained in sidesteps, ducks and dives within available reaction time. Evades observed threats.

Focus: Lifting.name: Focus: Lifting
Focus: Lifting.description: Trained to raise and reposition heavy objects with controlled force. Manages short carries safely.

Focus: Loadbearing.name: Focus: Loadbearing
Focus: Loadbearing.description: Trained to carry loads over distance without injury or dropped cargo. Paces effort over time.

Focus: Sleight of Hand.name: Focus: Sleight of Hand
Focus: Sleight of Hand.description: Trained in palming, switching and discreet object manipulation. Moves hands without detection.

Focus: Concentration.name: Focus: Concentration
Focus: Concentration.description: Trained to maintain focus through distractions, discomfort and pressure. Stays on task.

Focus: Perception.name: Focus: Perception
Focus: Perception.description: Trained to notice immediate sensory details: movement, displaced objects and changes. Stays alert.

Focus: Fishing.name: Focus: Fishing
Focus: Fishing.description: Trained to read aquatic conditions and use appropriate tackle. Judges where fish hold.

Focus: Hunting.name: Focus: Hunting
Focus: Hunting.description: Trained to judge quarry behaviour and plan an approach or stalk. Reads the ecology.

Focus: Tracking.name: Focus: Tracking
Focus: Tracking.description: Trained to follow prints, breaks and residue. Distinguishes observation from assumption.

Focus: Foraging.name: Focus: Foraging
Focus: Foraging.description: Trained to locate and identify familiar wild food, fuel and fibre. Avoids unknown organisms.

Focus: Trapping.name: Focus: Trapping
Focus: Trapping.description: Trained to place, bait and maintain capture devices for known quarry. Checks traps safely.

Focus: Sheltercraft.name: Focus: Sheltercraft
Focus: Sheltercraft.description: Trained to select sites and build field shelters from available materials. Works in harsh conditions.

Focus: Firecraft.name: Focus: Firecraft
Focus: Firecraft.description: Trained to establish and manage controlled fires. Selects fuel and extinguishes safely.

Focus: Weather Reading.name: Focus: Weather Reading
Focus: Weather Reading.description: Trained to interpret wind, cloud and pressure signs. Judges conditions for the coming hours.

Focus: Animal Handling.name: Focus: Animal Handling
Focus: Animal Handling.description: Trained to guide animal behaviour with learned cues and posture. Reads an animal's receptiveness.

Focus: Animal Care.name: Focus: Animal Care
Focus: Animal Care.description: Trained in feeding, housing and grooming familiar animals. Recognises common ailments.

Focus: Field Dressing.name: Focus: Field Dressing
Focus: Field Dressing.description: Trained to prepare a carcass for transport within safety requirements. Works in field conditions.

Focus: Navigation.name: Focus: Navigation
Focus: Navigation.description: Trained to determine routes and position from maps, landmarks and instruments. Finds the way.

Focus: Field Survey.name: Focus: Field Survey
Focus: Field Survey.description: Trained to record terrain, cover and water conditions. Reports observable environmental features.

Focus: Search.name: Focus: Search
Focus: Search.description: Trained to methodically examine an area using clues and elimination. Covers ground thoroughly.

Focus: Rescue.name: Focus: Rescue
Focus: Rescue.description: Trained in physical recovery from water, rubble, height or vehicles. Uses extraction equipment.

Focus: Persuasion.name: Focus: Persuasion
Focus: Persuasion.description: Trained to make reasoned appeals and structured arguments. Presents a case without coercion.

Focus: Bargaining.name: Focus: Bargaining
Focus: Bargaining.description: Trained to negotiate price and trade terms. Reads the other party's position.

Focus: Deception.name: Focus: Deception
Focus: Deception.description: Trained to construct and deliver misleading accounts. Maintains composure under scrutiny.

Focus: Intimidation.name: Focus: Intimidation
Focus: Intimidation.description: Trained to apply credible pressure through presence and manner. Shifts behaviour deliberately.

Focus: Leadership.name: Focus: Leadership
Focus: Leadership.description: Trained to rally participants, set direction and hold morale. Builds shared commitment.

Focus: Diplomacy.name: Focus: Diplomacy
Focus: Diplomacy.description: Trained to negotiate between parties with distinct interests. Frames acceptable terms.

Focus: Teaching.name: Focus: Teaching
Focus: Teaching.description: Trained to direct clear practice, explanation and feedback in a known subject. Corrects effectively.

Focus: Counseling.name: Focus: Counseling
Focus: Counseling.description: Trained to help others articulate concerns and weigh choices. Listens without directing.

Focus: Etiquette.name: Focus: Etiquette
Focus: Etiquette.description: Trained in social conventions of dress, address and precedence. Navigates formal settings.

Focus: Public Speaking.name: Focus: Public Speaking
Focus: Public Speaking.description: Trained to address groups clearly and hold attention. Structures speeches and briefings.

Focus: Interviewing.name: Focus: Interviewing
Focus: Interviewing.description: Trained to elicit accounts through structured questions and listening. Sequences an interview.

Focus: Mediation.name: Focus: Mediation
Focus: Mediation.description: Trained to help willing parties resolve disputes while preserving face. Keeps both sides heard.

Focus: Cooking.name: Focus: Cooking
Focus: Cooking.description: Trained in ingredient preparation, heat management and meal timing. Can run a kitchen station.

Focus: Baking.name: Focus: Baking
Focus: Baking.description: Trained in dough handling, proving and heat processes. Produces consistent bread and pastry.

Focus: Housekeeping.name: Focus: Housekeeping
Focus: Housekeeping.description: Trained to maintain clean domestic spaces, laundry and stores. Runs orderly routines.

Focus: Hospitality.name: Focus: Hospitality
Focus: Hospitality.description: Trained in guest reception, seating and service problem resolution. Manages a floor.

Focus: Food Preservation.name: Focus: Food Preservation
Focus: Food Preservation.description: Trained in drying, curing, sealing and cold storage methods. Keeps food safe long-term.

Focus: Fermentation.name: Focus: Fermentation
Focus: Fermentation.description: Trained to manage fermentation processes within material and food-safety limits. Monitors cultures.

Focus: Drink Mixing.name: Focus: Drink Mixing
Focus: Drink Mixing.description: Trained to measure and combine beverages to specification. Works with speed and consistency.

Focus: Cyrra Brewing.name: Focus: Cyrra Brewing
Focus: Cyrra Brewing.description: Trained in Cyrra grind, extraction and pour technique. Judges strength and timing.

Focus: Cultivation.name: Focus: Cultivation
Focus: Cultivation.description: Trained in crop needs, seasons and growing methods. Maintains an established plot.

Focus: Irrigation.name: Focus: Irrigation
Focus: Irrigation.description: Trained to manage water delivery, timing and drainage for growing systems. Prevents waterlogging.

Focus: Aquaculture.name: Focus: Aquaculture
Focus: Aquaculture.description: Trained in water quality, feeding schedules and aquatic cultivation systems. Maintains a working tank.

Focus: Butchery.name: Focus: Butchery
Focus: Butchery.description: Trained to portion familiar carcasses with proper tools and anatomy knowledge. Works a cutting station.

Focus: Food Testing.name: Focus: Food Testing
Focus: Food Testing.description: Trained to interpret food-quality and contamination test results. Flags unsafe batches.

Focus: Tailoring.name: Focus: Tailoring
Focus: Tailoring.description: Trained in fitting, mending and altering garments for known anatomy. Adjusts closures and seams.

Focus: Weaving.name: Focus: Weaving
Focus: Weaving.description: Trained to construct textile structures from cloth to cord. Works with practiced materials.

Focus: Dyeing.name: Focus: Dyeing
Focus: Dyeing.description: Trained in colour treatments, fixing agents and material compatibility. Produces consistent results.

Focus: Carpentry.name: Focus: Carpentry
Focus: Carpentry.description: Trained in wood joints, frames and fittings. Shapes stock with hand and power tools.

Focus: Metalworking.name: Focus: Metalworking
Focus: Metalworking.description: Trained to shape metal through force, forming and cutting processes. Handles stock and tooling.

Focus: Welding.name: Focus: Welding
Focus: Welding.description: Trained in powered joining processes: seam preparation, heat control and post-weld checks.

Focus: Glassworking.name: Focus: Glassworking
Focus: Glassworking.description: Trained to form and finish glass with supported tools and thermal controls. Shapes precise pieces.

Focus: Composite Fabrication.name: Focus: Composite Fabrication
Focus: Composite Fabrication.description: Trained in layup, curing and composite construction. Builds to material specification.

Focus: Machining.name: Focus: Machining
Focus: Machining.description: Trained to produce precise parts through controlled machine operation. Works to tight tolerances.

Focus: Assembly.name: Focus: Assembly
Focus: Assembly.description: Trained to fit components to specification in the correct order. Works to known tolerances.

Focus: Structural Design.name: Focus: Structural Design
Focus: Structural Design.description: Trained to plan load-bearing arrangements within known materials and engineering scope.

Focus: Surface Finishing.name: Focus: Surface Finishing
Focus: Surface Finishing.description: Trained in coatings, polish and texture application. Prepares surfaces to specification.

Focus: Armor Fitting.name: Focus: Armor Fitting
Focus: Armor Fitting.description: Trained to adjust protective gear to a wearer's body and movement. Ensures proper attachment.

Focus: Weapon Fitting.name: Focus: Weapon Fitting
Focus: Weapon Fitting.description: Trained to adjust weapon grip, balance and sights. Improves handling within the mechanism.

Focus: Materials Testing.name: Focus: Materials Testing
Focus: Materials Testing.description: Trained to evaluate material properties through supported tests. Interprets result limits.

Focus: Plumbing.name: Focus: Plumbing
Focus: Plumbing.description: Trained to diagnose and repair water and waste pipe systems. Follows safe isolation procedures.

Focus: Electrical Work.name: Focus: Electrical Work
Focus: Electrical Work.description: Trained to service known circuits, connections and protective devices. Works safely under load.

Focus: Power Systems.name: Focus: Power Systems
Focus: Power Systems.description: Trained to operate power generation and storage installations. Manages cells and converters.

Focus: Water Treatment.name: Focus: Water Treatment
Focus: Water Treatment.description: Trained to operate treatment processes and judge output quality. Manages dosing and filters.

Focus: Climate Systems.name: Focus: Climate Systems
Focus: Climate Systems.description: Trained to service air, humidity and filtration equipment. Maintains environmental controls.

Focus: Thermal Systems.name: Focus: Thermal Systems
Focus: Thermal Systems.description: Trained to operate and service heat-transfer equipment. Manages exchangers and shutdown.

Focus: Mechanics.name: Focus: Mechanics
Focus: Mechanics.description: Trained to diagnose and repair moving mechanisms, drives and linkages. Identifies failure points.

Focus: Electronics.name: Focus: Electronics
Focus: Electronics.description: Trained in component-level repair and board assembly. Handles precision soldering.

Focus: Diagnostics.name: Focus: Diagnostics
Focus: Diagnostics.description: Trained to isolate faults using device measurements and controlled comparisons. Reads test output.

Focus: Inspection.name: Focus: Inspection
Focus: Inspection.description: Trained to recognise defects, wear and non-conformance. States what remains unverified.

Focus: Repair Planning.name: Focus: Repair Planning
Focus: Repair Planning.description: Trained to sequence repair work and estimate parts, risks and dependencies. Plans efficiently.

Focus: Maintenance Planning.name: Focus: Maintenance Planning
Focus: Maintenance Planning.description: Trained to schedule preventive service around condition and workload. Avoids unplanned downtime.

Focus: Salvage.name: Focus: Salvage
Focus: Salvage.description: Trained to assess recoverable equipment for condition and practical reuse. Judges what is worth saving.

Focus: Reclamation.name: Focus: Reclamation
Focus: Reclamation.description: Trained to recover usable material from waste streams. Handles sorting and separation safely.

Focus: Programming.name: Focus: Programming
Focus: Programming.description: Trained to write and modify software in learned languages. Works within accessible systems.

Focus: Data Analysis.name: Focus: Data Analysis
Focus: Data Analysis.description: Trained to transform and interpret data while preserving uncertainty. Draws supported conclusions.

Decline optional bundle.name: Decline optional bundle
Decline optional bundle.description:
keep only the common basics everyone starts with (clothing, bag, body support) and nothing extra. No cash refund for declining; the opening scenario controls what you have and where.

Choose this if your character concept does not need a starting toolkit, or if you want to acquire gear through play instead.
Decline optional bundle.traitNarrativeEffects: The character starts with only the universal common basics — appropriate clothing, a personal bag and standard body support for their species. No additional tools, instruments or supplies. They must acquire anything beyond basics through play: purchase, gift, salvage or assignment. This is a deliberate choice, not poverty.

Travel basics.name: Travel basics
Travel basics.description:
a minimal personal kit for someone on the move. Includes a personal notes medium for keeping records, plans and contacts. Common clothing and bag are supplied separately.

Good for characters who travel light and figure things out as they go.
Travel basics.traitNarrativeEffects: The character carries a personal notes medium — whatever format suits their species and technology level (datapad, notebook, recording device). They can take notes, record observations and keep a personal log. The notes medium is personal property, not secure communication equipment.

Study set.name: Study set
Study set.description:
for a character actively learning. Includes a personal notes medium and learning notes (structured study materials for their current subject). Common clothing and bag are supplied separately.

Good for students, apprentices and anyone pursuing structured learning.
Study set.traitNarrativeEffects: The character carries study materials appropriate to their current learning. The notes medium records their own work; the learning notes contain structured reference material from their course of study. These are personal educational property, not institutional credentials or restricted texts.

Portable repair set.name: Portable repair set
Portable repair set.description:
for a character who fixes things. Includes a small hand-tool roll, an inspection aid (magnifier, probe or diagnostic light) and a personal notes medium. Common clothing and bag are supplied separately.

Good for mechanics, handyworkers and anyone who keeps things running.
Portable repair set.traitNarrativeEffects: The character carries basic hand tools suitable for common repairs — fastener drivers, cutters, grips, a small pry tool, plus an inspection aid for close examination. The tools are portable and general-purpose, not specialised or industrial. They can attempt basic repairs on household and personal equipment without needing to find tools first.

Diagnostic set.name: Diagnostic set
Diagnostic set.description:
for a character who troubleshoots technical systems. Includes a civilian diagnostic reader, compatible diagnostic leads and a personal notes medium. Common clothing and bag are supplied separately.

Good for technicians, engineers and system troubleshooters.
Diagnostic set.traitNarrativeEffects: The character carries a civilian-grade diagnostic reader and leads — equipment for reading system status, identifying faults and checking connections on standard civilian technology. The reader is not military-grade, not restricted and not a hacking tool. It reads what systems are designed to report.

Service set.name: Service set

Service set.traitNarrativeEffects: The character carries a service apron — a practical work garment with pockets, loops and protective covering suitable for their service role. The apron is functional workwear, not a uniform with institutional authority. It signals readiness to work and provides practical carrying capacity for service tools.

Good for cooks, brewers and anyone whose craft involves food.
Food craft set.traitNarrativeEffects: The character carries portable food-preparation tools and personal recipe notes. The tools are suitable for preparing meals and drinks in a variety of settings — kitchen, field, galley. The recipe notes are their own collection, reflecting their training and preferences.

Fieldwork set.name: Fieldwork set
Fieldwork set.description:
for a character who works outdoors or in the field. Includes a personal notes medium and a field observation aid (distance viewer, sample container or environmental sensor). Common clothing and bag are supplied separately.

Good for scouts, surveyors, researchers and anyone working outside controlled environments.
Fieldwork set.traitNarrativeEffects: The character carries a field observation aid — equipment for examining, measuring or recording conditions in the field. The specific tool depends on their field of work (distance viewer for scouts, sample kit for researchers, sensor for environmental workers). Paired with their notes medium for recording observations.

Textile set.name: Textile set
Textile set.description:
for a character who works with fabrics and materials. Includes textile fitting tools (measuring, cutting and pinning implements) and mending supplies. Common clothing and bag are supplied separately.

Good for tailors, armour fitters, sailmakers and anyone who works with fabric or flexible materials.
Textile set.traitNarrativeEffects: The character carries textile fitting tools and mending supplies — everything needed for measuring, cutting, fitting and repairing fabric, leather and flexible materials. These are portable craft tools, not industrial equipment. They can alter clothing, repair damage to flexible gear and create basic textile items in the field.

Cargo set.name: Cargo set
Cargo set.description:
for a character who handles freight and heavy loads. Includes work gloves, cargo securing straps and a personal notes medium for tracking loads. Common clothing and bag are supplied separately.

Good for dock workers, freight handlers, logistics workers and anyone who moves heavy things.
Cargo set.traitNarrativeEffects: The character carries practical cargo-handling equipment — protective gloves and securing straps for managing loads safely. The straps can secure cargo for transport, tie down loose items or improvise carrying solutions. Their notes medium tracks manifests, weights and destinations.

Trade set.name: Trade set
Trade set.description:
for a character involved in commerce. Includes a personal trade ledger, an appraisal and measuring aid and a reusable storage pouch. Common clothing and bag are supplied separately.

Good for traders, merchants, appraisers and anyone who buys, sells or evaluates goods.
Trade set.traitNarrativeEffects: The character carries trade tools — a ledger for recording transactions and debts, an appraisal aid for measuring and evaluating goods (scales, rulers, testing implements), and a secure pouch for samples or small valuables. These are the tools of everyday commerce, not restricted financial instruments.

Records set.name: Records set
Records set.description:
for a character who works with documentation. Includes a personal notes medium and civilian reference extracts (copies of commonly needed regulations, procedures or reference material). Common clothing and bag are supplied separately.

Good for clerks, administrators, legal workers and anyone who manages records.
Records set.traitNarrativeEffects: The character carries documentation tools — their own notes medium and a collection of civilian reference extracts relevant to their field. The extracts are public reference material, not restricted documents or security clearances. They can look up procedures, check regulations and verify standard information without needing to visit an archive.

Research set.name: Research set
Research set.description:
for a character conducting structured investigation. Includes a personal notes medium and a research measurement aid (calibrated instrument appropriate to their field). Common clothing and bag are supplied separately.

Good for researchers, scientists, analysts and anyone who measures things carefully.
Research set.traitNarrativeEffects: The character carries research equipment — a personal notes medium for recording findings and a calibrated measurement instrument suited to their research field. The measurement aid is civilian-grade and field-portable, not laboratory or restricted equipment. They can take accurate measurements and record structured observations.

Computing set.name: Computing set
Computing set.description:
for a character who works with information systems. Includes a personal computing interface (portable device for data work, communication and general computing). Common clothing and bag are supplied separately.

Good for programmers, data workers, communications specialists and anyone whose work is primarily digital.
Computing set.traitNarrativeEffects: The character carries a personal computing interface — a portable device for data processing, communication and general computing tasks. The device is civilian-grade personal technology, not a restricted system terminal or military-grade equipment. It connects to available civilian networks and runs standard software.

Care set.name: Care set
Care set.description:
for a character trained in basic medical response. Includes a first-aid supply pack with bandages, antiseptics, basic wound care tools and stabilisation supplies. Common clothing and bag are supplied separately.

Good for caregivers, first responders, field medics and anyone expected to provide immediate medical help.
Care set.traitNarrativeEffects: The character carries a first-aid pack — supplies for immediate wound care, stabilisation and basic medical response. The pack is civilian first-aid grade, not a full medical kit or surgical equipment. They can clean wounds, apply bandages, stabilise fractures and manage shock with what they carry.

Resonance service set.name: Resonance service set
Resonance service set.description:
for a character working with magical or resonance-based systems. Includes a resonance service aid (tuning fork, field probe or calibration tool) and a personal notes medium. Common clothing and bag are supplied separately.

Good for magic practitioners, resonance technicians and anyone who maintains or works with magical infrastructure.
Resonance service set.traitNarrativeEffects: The character carries a resonance service aid — a tool for interacting with magical fields and resonance systems at a basic maintenance level. The aid detects field presence, checks calibration and assists with routine resonance work. It is a service tool, not a weapon or a casting focus.

Performance set.name: Performance set
Performance set.description:
for a character who performs. Includes a personal performance kit (instrument, props or staging tools appropriate to their discipline). Common clothing and bag are supplied separately.

Good for musicians, entertainers, public speakers and anyone whose work involves an audience.
Performance set.traitNarrativeEffects: The character carries a personal performance kit — whatever tools their discipline requires (an instrument, vocal preparation supplies, props, staging materials). The kit is personal and portable, not a full stage setup. They can practice, perform small-venue shows and maintain their instrument or materials independently.

Visual art set.name: Visual art set
Visual art set.description:
for a character who creates visual art. Includes visual art supplies (drawing, painting or sculpting tools appropriate to their medium). Common clothing and bag are supplied separately.

Good for artists, illustrators, designers and anyone who expresses themselves visually.
Visual art set.traitNarrativeEffects: The character carries visual art supplies — portable materials for their chosen medium (drawing implements, paints, sculpting tools, digital art hardware). The supplies are personal and field-portable, suitable for working in varied conditions. They can sketch, paint, sculpt or design wherever they are.

Protection set.name: Protection set
Protection set.description:
for a character in a protective or security role. Includes a basic protective vest and an ordinary signalling aid (whistle, light or communication device). Common clothing and bag are supplied separately.

Good for security workers, escorts, watchkeepers and anyone in a civilian protection role.
Protection set.traitNarrativeEffects: The character carries a basic protective vest — light civilian body protection offering limited defence against common hazards — and a signalling aid for calling attention or communicating over short distances. This is civilian protection equipment, not military armour or restricted security gear. It signals a protective role without claiming authority.

Training set.name: Training set
Training set.description:
for a character who trains regularly. Includes a padded training vest (impact protection for drills and sparring) and personal training notes (routines, progress records). Common clothing and bag are supplied separately.

Good for martial artists, athletes, combat students and anyone in structured physical training.
Training set.traitNarrativeEffects: The character carries a padded training vest — protective gear for drills and sparring that reduces impact without restricting movement — and personal training notes recording their routines, progress and techniques. The vest is practice equipment, not combat armour. They are equipped to train safely in a variety of settings.

Magic craft set.name: Magic craft set
Magic craft set.description:
for a character practising learned magic. Includes basic inscription supplies (stylus, ink, prepared surfaces) and learning notes (structured reference for their magical discipline). Common clothing and bag are supplied separately.

Good for magic students, inscription practitioners and anyone studying the learned craft.
Magic craft set.traitNarrativeEffects: The character carries basic inscription supplies — the physical tools needed to create magical inscriptions and practise workings — and learning notes from their magical discipline. The supplies are student-grade and field-portable, not master-quality or restricted materials. They can practise inscriptions, study technique and attempt basic workings with what they carry.
