Starian — Nexara.name: Starian — Nexara
Starian — Nexara.description:
Born and raised on Nexara. You grew up on the Starian homeworld — familiar with its cities, customs, seasons and social expectations. Nexara is what you know, and you navigate it with the ease of a local.

This is your formative origin, not your current citizenship or travel permission. Where you live now and who you work for are separate choices.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Presence; +5 Etiquette.
Starian — Nexara.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Starian from Nexara. Native dress palette follows the character's home city. Carries themselves with local familiarity — confident, unhurried posture in Nexaran environments. Human-passing Starian biology per Race trait.

Your formative origin, not current citizenship or travel permission. Default bonuses: +1 Presence; +5 Etiquette. Optional explicit adjustments: Starian — Nexara · PRE · Navigation => [Creator adjustment] Starian — Nexara / 2; Starian — Nexara · END · Etiquette => [Creator adjustment] Starian — Nexara / 3; Starian — Nexara · END · Navigation => [Creator adjustment] Starian — Nexara / 4. Apply at most one before the opening floor check; never choose one for the player.

Human — Terra.name: Human — Terra
Human — Terra.description:
Born and raised on Terra (Earth). You grew up on humanity's homeworld before coming to Nexara — carrying Terran habits, education and cultural expectations into a society that works differently.

Terran Humans on Nexara are immigrants navigating unfamiliar customs, technology conventions and social structures. Your Earth background is both an asset (different perspective) and a gap (missing local knowledge).

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Intellect; +5 Research.
Human — Terra.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Human from Terra (Earth). Clothing shows Terran-import styling — slightly different cut and material from Nexaran fashion, cleaner machine-finished seams, subtly foreign proportions in collar and cuff. Carries imported personal items rather than Nexaran-standard gear.

Your formative origin, not current citizenship or travel permission. Default bonuses: +1 Intellect; +5 Research. Optional explicit adjustments: Human — Terra · INT · Hospitality => [Creator adjustment] Human — Terra / 2; Human — Terra · CHA · Research => [Creator adjustment] Human — Terra / 3; Human — Terra · CHA · Hospitality => [Creator adjustment] Human — Terra / 4. Apply at most one before the opening floor check; never choose one for the player.

Human — Xeon.name: Human — Xeon
Human — Xeon.description:
Born and raised on Xeon. You grew up on the major trade hub world — comfortable with mixed-species commerce, varied customs and the practical adaptability that comes from a crossroads culture.

Xeon-raised Humans are used to negotiating across cultural lines and reading unfamiliar situations quickly. On Nexara, you bring trade-station awareness but lack local roots.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Awareness; +5 Bargaining.
Human — Xeon.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Human from Xeon. Clothing shows Xeon trade-hub styling — mixed-origin layered practical garments, adapted fabrics, visible utility in every piece. Carries themselves with trade-station awareness — alert, economical movement.

Your formative origin, not current citizenship or travel permission. Default bonuses: +1 Awareness; +5 Bargaining. Optional explicit adjustments: Human — Xeon · AWR · Logistics => [Creator adjustment] Human — Xeon / 2; Human — Xeon · CHA · Bargaining => [Creator adjustment] Human — Xeon / 3; Human — Xeon · CHA · Logistics => [Creator adjustment] Human — Xeon / 4. Apply at most one before the opening floor check; never choose one for the player.

Human — orbital/station.name: Human — orbital/station
Human — orbital/station.description:
Raised on an orbital station or habitat. You grew up in a contained environment — tight corridors, recycled air, maintained infrastructure and a community where everyone's role matters.

Station-raised characters are used to checking systems, managing resources carefully and living in close quarters. On a planet's surface, open sky and uncontrolled weather are still unfamiliar.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Awareness; +5 Inspection.
Human — orbital/station.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Human raised on orbital or station. Clothing shows tight-clearance station-practical styling — close-fitting layers, secure fastenings, nothing loose or trailing. Compact posture, efficient use of space. Slightly paler complexion common to station-raised Humans.

Your formative origin, not current citizenship or travel permission. Default bonuses: +1 Awareness; +5 Inspection. Optional explicit adjustments: Human — orbital/station · AWR · Logistics => [Creator adjustment] Human — orbital/station / 2; Human — orbital/station · RES · Inspection => [Creator adjustment] Human — orbital/station / 3; Human — orbital/station · RES · Logistics => [Creator adjustment] Human — orbital/station / 4. Apply at most one before the opening floor check; never choose one for the player.

Kharai — Terra, Terran lineage.name: Kharai — Terra, Terran lineage
Kharai — Terra, Terran lineage.description:
Kharai, Terran lineage, raised on Terra. You grew up among Terran cultures with a humanoid feline body — cat ears, tail, feline eyes and enhanced senses that set you apart from your Human neighbours.

Terran Kharai navigate a world that wasn't designed for their senses or body. Your feline hearing, night vision and reflexes are natural advantages, but Terran social norms may not always account for them.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Awareness; +5 Perception.
Kharai — Terra, Terran lineage.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Kharai, Terran lineage. Humanoid frame with genuine FELINE ears set high on the skull (triangular, furred, mobile — not human ears, not headband accessories), functional feline tail, vertical-slit feline pupils with reflective tapetum, fine velvety facial fur over real bone structure. Build ranges from lithe to sturdy but retains feline proportions. Terran-raised cultural bearing — integrates with mixed-species society naturally.

Your formative origin, not current citizenship or travel permission. Default bonuses: +1 Awareness; +5 Perception. Optional explicit adjustments: Kharai — Terra, Terran lineage · AWR · Mediation => [Creator adjustment] Kharai — Terra, Terran lineage / 2; Kharai — Terra, Terran lineage · CHA · Perception => [Creator adjustment] Kharai — Terra, Terran lineage / 3; Kharai — Terra, Terran lineage · CHA · Mediation => [Creator adjustment] Kharai — Terra, Terran lineage / 4. Apply at most one before the opening floor check; never choose one for the player.

Kharai — Xeon, Xeon lineage.name: Kharai — Xeon, Xeon lineage
Kharai — Xeon, Xeon lineage.description:
Kharai, Xeon lineage, raised on Xeon. You grew up as a fully bipedal feline on the trade hub world — complete fur, animal-shaped head, clawed hands and a body built for climbing and quick movement.

Xeon Kharai are more visually distinct than their Terran cousins. On Xeon, mixed-species life is routine; on Nexara, your full-feline appearance draws more attention.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Awareness; +5 Perception.
Kharai — Xeon, Xeon lineage.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Kharai, Xeon lineage. Full bipedal feline — complete fur covering in natural feline patterns and colours, animal-shaped head with muzzle, whiskers, prominent feline nose, feline ears atop skull, vertical-slit eyes with tapetum, digitigrade legs, padded paw-like hands with retractable claws, full feline tail. Larger and more powerfully built than Terran Kharai. Carries themselves with physical confidence. NEVER a cartoon cat, never cute, never a mascot.

Your formative origin, not current citizenship or travel permission. Default bonuses: +1 Awareness; +5 Perception. Optional explicit adjustments: Kharai — Xeon, Xeon lineage · AWR · Teaching => [Creator adjustment] Kharai — Xeon, Xeon lineage / 2; Kharai — Xeon, Xeon lineage · PRE · Perception => [Creator adjustment] Kharai — Xeon, Xeon lineage / 3; Kharai — Xeon, Xeon lineage · PRE · Teaching => [Creator adjustment] Kharai — Xeon, Xeon lineage / 4. Apply at most one before the opening floor check; never choose one for the player.

Rivani — Terra, Terran lineage.name: Rivani — Terra, Terran lineage
Rivani — Terra, Terran lineage.description:
Rivani, Terran lineage, raised on Terra. You grew up with a humanoid body featuring rounded rodent ears, a balancing tail and large expressive eyes — smaller in stature but precise and quick with your hands.

Terran Rivani often gravitate toward assembly, repair and craft work. Your fine motor control is a natural advantage in detailed tasks.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Agility; +5 Assembly.
Rivani — Terra, Terran lineage.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Rivani, Terran lineage. Humanoid frame with genuine RODENT ears set high on the skull (large, rounded, thin-skinned, mobile — not human ears), functional balancing tail, large dark expressive eyes. Slightly compact stature (shorter than average human). Fine soft facial features, nimble hands with precise dexterity. Terran-raised cultural bearing — confident and well-groomed. NEVER vermin-like, never hunched or furtive.

Your formative origin, not current citizenship or travel permission. Default bonuses: +1 Agility; +5 Assembly. Optional explicit adjustments: Rivani — Terra, Terran lineage · AGI · Inspection => [Creator adjustment] Rivani — Terra, Terran lineage / 2; Rivani — Terra, Terran lineage · INT · Assembly => [Creator adjustment] Rivani — Terra, Terran lineage / 3; Rivani — Terra, Terran lineage · INT · Inspection => [Creator adjustment] Rivani — Terra, Terran lineage / 4. Apply at most one before the opening floor check; never choose one for the player.

Rivani — Xeon, Xeon lineage.name: Rivani — Xeon, Xeon lineage
Rivani — Xeon, Xeon lineage.description:
Rivani, Xeon lineage, raised on Xeon. You grew up as a fully bipedal rodent on the trade hub — complete fur, animal-shaped head, prominent ears, large dark eyes and visible incisors.

Xeon Rivani are built for tight spaces and delicate work. Your small frame and exceptional hand-eye coordination make you invaluable in assembly, repair and inspection roles.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Agility; +5 Assembly.
Rivani — Xeon, Xeon lineage.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Rivani, Xeon lineage. Full bipedal rodent — complete fur covering in natural tones, animal-shaped head with muzzle, whiskers, prominent rounded ears, large dark eyes, visible front incisors, prehensile tail. Compact sturdy build, plantigrade or digitigrade hind feet, dexterous paw-hands. Carries themselves with artisan dignity and precision. NEVER dirty, never furtive, never comic-relief. Rivani Xeon are master craftspeople and traders.

Your formative origin, not current citizenship or travel permission. Default bonuses: +1 Agility; +5 Assembly. Optional explicit adjustments: Rivani — Xeon, Xeon lineage · AGI · Appraisal => [Creator adjustment] Rivani — Xeon, Xeon lineage / 2; Rivani — Xeon, Xeon lineage · AWR · Assembly => [Creator adjustment] Rivani — Xeon, Xeon lineage / 3; Rivani — Xeon, Xeon lineage · AWR · Appraisal => [Creator adjustment] Rivani — Xeon, Xeon lineage / 4. Apply at most one before the opening floor check; never choose one for the player.

Olyth — Terra.name: Olyth — Terra
Olyth — Terra.description:
Olyth raised on Terra. You grew up as an adaptive living-matter being on humanity's homeworld — maintaining a stable bipedal form while your surface may show subtle Terran environmental influence: warmer colours, slightly more opaque skin.

Olyth on Terra learn early to present a consistent appearance in a society that can find shifting surfaces unsettling. Your material-testing instincts come from a body that understands structure intimately.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Resolve; +5 Materials Testing.
Olyth — Terra.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Olyth from Terra. Adaptive living-matter body maintains stable bipedal form. Surface may show subtle Terran environmental influence — warmer colour cast, slightly more opaque skin, denser-looking internal cores. Terran-raised bearing means more conventional body language and spatial habits.

Your formative origin, not current citizenship or travel permission. Default bonuses: +1 Resolve; +5 Materials Testing. Olyth — Xeon.name: Olyth — Xeon
Olyth — Xeon.description:
Olyth raised on Xeon. You grew up as an adaptive living-matter being on the trade hub — maintaining a stable form while navigating a mixed-species world that is more accustomed to physical variety.

Xeon Olyth may show cooler pearlescent tones and more visible internal luminous structure from the station environment. Your inspection skills reflect a body attuned to material integrity.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Resolve; +5 Inspection.
Olyth — Xeon.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Olyth from Xeon. Adaptive living-matter body maintains stable bipedal form. Surface may show Xeon environmental influence — cooler pearlescent tones, more visible internal luminous structures, slightly more fluid resting posture. Carries themselves with Xeon-characteristic efficiency and directness.

Your formative origin, not current citizenship or travel permission. Default bonuses: +1 Resolve; +5 Inspection. Zencadian — Vigil.name: Zencadian — Vigil
Zencadian — Vigil.description:
Zencadian raised on the Vigil. You grew up among your own species' institutions — surrounded by systematic thinking, interface technology and the patient observation culture that defines Zencadian society.

Vigil-raised Zencadians carry visible personal hardware and are comfortable with complex systems. Your maintenance and planning skills reflect a culture built around sustained infrastructure.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Resolve; +5 Maintenance Planning.
Zencadian — Vigil.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Zencadian from the Vigil. Grey-skinned, tall, angular frame with large dark eyes and long fingers. Vigil-raised Zencadians carry visible personal hardware — small mounted devices, interface housings, data-access points built into clothing or attached to the body. Technology is external and deliberately maintained, never biological. Precise, measured body language.

Your formative origin, not current citizenship or travel permission. Default bonuses: +1 Resolve; +5 Maintenance Planning. Apply at most one before the opening floor check; never choose one for the player.

Elyri — Aethrys.name: Elyri — Aethrys
Elyri — Aethrys.description:
Elyri raised on Aethrys. You grew up on the Elyri homeworld where aether energy is abundant — your physical shell shows strong characteristic colouration, vivid energy channels and a pronounced core glow.

Aethrys-raised Elyri have the strongest natural connection to aether fields. Your concentration skills reflect a culture built around managing and channeling living energy.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Resolve; +5 Concentration.
Elyri — Aethrys.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Elyri from Aethrys. Physical shell with aether core shows strong Aethrys-characteristic colouration — energy channels more vivid, core glow at sternum more pronounced, translucent areas more defined. Hair-analogue is luminous energy-formed material in the individual's signature colour. Carries themselves with quiet certainty — physically grounded despite visible internal radiance.

Your formative origin, not current citizenship or travel permission. Default bonuses: +1 Resolve; +5 Concentration. Apply at most one before the opening floor check; never choose one for the player.

Civic neighborhood.name: Civic neighborhood
Civic neighborhood.description:
you grew up in a community-oriented setting: shared errands, familiar neighbours and everyday social routines. You learned to read people, mediate small disputes and keep a household running smoothly.

This is your raised background, separate from your faction or current life. The skills you picked up are social and practical, not professional.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Charisma; +5 Hospitality, +5 Mediation.
Civic neighborhood.traitNarrativeEffects: The character grew up surrounded by neighbours and community routines. They know how to navigate casual social situations, introduce themselves comfortably and read the mood of a room. Small-scale mediation and hospitality come naturally — they have hosted guests, settled minor disagreements and organised shared events. Their social instincts are practical, not political. They default to neighbourly trust but recognise when someone does not fit the local pattern.

Workshop household.name: Workshop household
Workshop household.description:
you grew up around tools, repairs and supervised bench work. Fixing things, inspecting parts and understanding how objects are assembled was part of daily life.

This is your raised background, separate from any professional training. You have practical hands and an eye for how things fit together, even if you never completed a formal apprenticeship.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Intellect; +5 Assembly, +5 Inspection.
Workshop household.traitNarrativeEffects: The character grew up handling tools and watching repairs. They instinctively check how things are put together, notice when a fastener is wrong or a joint is stressed, and feel comfortable picking up unfamiliar hand tools. Their understanding is practical and tactile — they learn by taking things apart, not from manuals. They keep a tidy workspace by habit and treat borrowed tools with care.

Service household.name: Service household
Service household.description:
you grew up in a home where guests were regular and practical care was routine. Hospitality, housekeeping and attending to other people's needs were everyday expectations.

This is your raised background, separate from any current employment. You know how to make people comfortable, anticipate needs and manage a household efficiently.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Charisma; +5 Hospitality, +5 Housekeeping.
Service household.traitNarrativeEffects: The character grew up serving and hosting. They read body language for comfort or distress, anticipate what a guest needs before being asked, and maintain clean, organised spaces by reflex. They are comfortable in formal service situations and know the difference between attentive and intrusive. Their care instincts extend to practical tasks — clean linens, prepared food, a room made ready.

Academic household.name: Academic household
Academic household.description:
you grew up surrounded by books, questions and ordinary learning. Curiosity, reading and structured thinking were household values, even without any formal institutional degree.

This is your raised background, separate from any current studies. You are comfortable with research, focused reading and following a line of inquiry to its conclusion.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Intellect; +5 Research, +5 Concentration.
Academic household.traitNarrativeEffects: The character grew up in a home that valued learning. They are comfortable with extended reading, take notes by habit, and approach unfamiliar subjects by looking for structure and first principles. They ask clarifying questions naturally and can hold a line of thought through interruptions. Their learning style is self-directed — they know how to find information even when no teacher is available.

Trade and port household.name: Trade and port household
Trade and port household.description:
you grew up around supplies, routes and exchanges. Cargo, logistics, bargaining and the rhythm of shipments coming and going were part of daily life.

This is your raised background, separate from any current trade position. You understand how goods move, what things cost and how to negotiate a fair exchange.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Awareness; +5 Bargaining, +5 Logistics.
Trade and port household.traitNarrativeEffects: The character grew up around commerce and shipping. They estimate quantities by eye, recognise common trade goods and packaging, and understand the basics of supply, demand and transit timing. Haggling feels natural and they spot inflated prices or suspicious deals quickly. They are comfortable in busy market or port environments and can navigate the social dynamics of traders, brokers and dock workers.

Agrarian household.name: Agrarian household
Agrarian household.description:
you grew up with seasonal work, known crops and the rhythms of cultivation. Planting, harvesting, preserving food and reading weather were part of your daily routine.

This is your raised background, separate from any current occupation. You understand growing cycles, soil and food preservation, and you are comfortable with sustained physical work outdoors.

📊 Default bonuses: +1 Endurance; +5 Cultivation, +5 Food Preservation.
Agrarian household.traitNarrativeEffects: The character grew up working land or managed growing environments. Calm.name: Calm
Calm.description:
you tend to pause before reacting. In tense situations, your instinct is to slow down, assess and respond deliberately rather than act on the first impulse.

This is a personality tendency, not a guarantee. Extreme situations can break anyone's composure.

+1 Resolve. An optional second tendency belongs in your Background.
Calm.traitNarrativeEffects: The character defaults to measured, deliberate responses. Under pressure, they pause rather than react. Others may read this as steady confidence or frustrating passivity depending on context. They speak after thinking, not before, and are hard to provoke into hasty action. Their calm is a habit, not a superpower — sustained stress, exhaustion or personal stakes can erode it.

Curious.name: Curious
Curious.description:
you ask questions and follow promising details. When something does not make sense, you want to know why. You are drawn to information, explanations and the satisfaction of understanding.

This is a personality tendency, not a compulsion. You still have judgement about when to ask and when to leave well enough alone.

+1 Intellect. An optional second tendency belongs in your Background.
Curious.traitNarrativeEffects: The character asks questions and investigates. They notice gaps in explanations, follow up on interesting details and are drawn to anything unusual or unexplained. Their curiosity is genuine, not performative — they want to understand, not just to be seen asking. This can lead them into situations others would avoid. They retain information well because they were paying attention when they learned it.

Observant.name: Observant
Observant.description:
you notice changes in familiar surroundings. A moved object, an unfamiliar face, a shift in someone's routine — small details register where others see only the background.

This is a personality tendency, not supernatural awareness. You notice what you have context to notice.

+1 Awareness. An optional second tendency belongs in your Background.
Observant.traitNarrativeEffects: The character notices details that others miss. They track small environmental changes — a moved chair, a new scratch on a surface, a person standing where no one usually stands. Their observation is passive and continuous; they do not need to actively search to pick up on changes. This makes them hard to surprise in familiar environments but can also make them hypervigilant or unsettled in chaotic, unfamiliar spaces.

Sociable.name: Sociable
Sociable.description:
you enjoy starting conversations and connecting with people. Social situations energise you and you find it natural to approach strangers, join groups and keep a conversation flowing.

This is a personality tendency, not universal charm. Not everyone wants to talk.

+1 Charisma. An optional second tendency belongs in your Background.
Sociable.traitNarrativeEffects: The character initiates social contact readily. They introduce themselves, ask about others and can sustain conversation across social gaps. They are comfortable in crowds, at events and with strangers. Their sociability is genuine — they like people — but it does not guarantee they are liked in return. They may misjudge when someone wants to be left alone or push social connection where it is unwelcome.

Assured.name: Assured
Assured.description:
you are comfortable taking a visible role. Whether leading a group, presenting an idea or stepping forward when someone needs to, you do not shrink from attention.

This is a personality tendency, not authority or expertise. Confidence does not make you right.

+1 Presence. An optional second tendency belongs in your Background.
Assured.traitNarrativeEffects: The character steps forward naturally. They are comfortable being the one who speaks, decides or takes visible responsibility. Others tend to look to them in uncertain moments. Their assurance comes from temperament, not rank — they carry themselves as though they belong in any room, which can read as leadership or as presumption depending on context.

Persistent.name: Persistent
Persistent.description:
you keep a steady effort going even when progress is slow. Where others might move on, you stay with the task, trusting that consistent work eventually pays off.

This is a personality tendency, not stubbornness. You can recognise when something truly is not working.

+1 Endurance. An optional second tendency belongs in your Background.
Persistent.traitNarrativeEffects: The character does not give up easily. They maintain effort through frustration, setbacks and boredom, returning to a task until it is done. Others may see this as admirable dedication or pointless stubbornness depending on the situation. They are reliable for long-term projects but can struggle to pivot when circumstances demand a change in approach.

Hands-on.name: Hands-on
Hands-on.description:
you like learning through careful manipulation and physical interaction. Diagrams and instructions are fine, but you understand something best when you can touch it, move it and see how it responds.

This is a personality tendency, not a skill. Wanting to touch something does not mean you know how to fix it.

+1 Agility. An optional second tendency belongs in your Background.
Hands-on.traitNarrativeEffects: The character learns by doing. They reach for objects, test mechanisms and explore through physical interaction. They are most comfortable when they can handle the thing they are trying to understand. This makes them quick practical learners but sometimes impatient with purely theoretical instruction. They have good spatial awareness and instinctive fine motor coordination.

Physical.name: Physical
Physical.description:
you enjoy work that involves bodily effort. Lifting, carrying, building, moving — you are drawn to tasks where your body is the primary tool and you feel best after a day of real exertion.

This is a personality tendency, not exceptional strength. You still have your species' normal physical limits.

+1 Strength. An optional second tendency belongs in your Background.
Physical.traitNarrativeEffects: The character gravitates toward physical activity. They prefer action to discussion, choose the hands-on approach and are restless when confined to sedentary work. Their physical confidence translates into comfort with heavy loads, rough terrain and demanding manual labour. They may undervalue intellectual or social approaches to problems when a physical one is available.

Patient.name: Patient
Patient.description:
you are willing to give a task, a person or a situation the time it needs. Rushing feels wrong to you, and you trust that steady attention produces better results than forced urgency.

This is a personality tendency, not passivity. You still act when waiting is no longer productive.

+1 Resolve. An optional second tendency belongs in your Background.
Patient.traitNarrativeEffects: The character waits well. They do not rush decisions, give people time to speak and accept that some processes cannot be accelerated. Others may experience this as calming stability or maddening slowness depending on the urgency of the situation. They are good at stakeouts, negotiations and any task that requires sustained attention without action.

Analytical.name: Analytical
Analytical.description:
you like comparing explanations, testing assumptions and finding the structure underneath a problem. Your instinct is to break things down before deciding how to act.

This is a personality tendency, not genius. Analysis takes time and can lead to paralysis.

+1 Intellect. An optional second tendency belongs in your Background.
Analytical.traitNarrativeEffects: The character approaches problems systematically. They compare options, look for patterns, and are sceptical of explanations that do not hold together. They prefer decisions backed by evidence and can spot logical gaps in arguments. This makes them effective troubleshooters but sometimes slow to act when quick judgement is needed — they want more data when there is none to be had.

Attentive.name: Attentive
Attentive.description:
you listen closely to people and surroundings. You hear what is said and what is not said, and you register changes in tone, expression and environment that others filter out.

This is a personality tendency, not mind-reading. You notice cues but still have to interpret them.

+1 Awareness. An optional second tendency belongs in your Background.
Attentive.traitNarrativeEffects: The character listens before they speak. They pick up on tone shifts, uncomfortable silences and environmental sounds that others tune out. In conversation, they remember what someone said three topics ago and connect it to what is being said now. Their attention is receptive, not interrogative — people often feel heard around them, which builds trust quickly.

Warm.name: Warm
Warm.description:
you often express care openly. Checking on people, offering help, sharing food or simply being present when someone is struggling comes naturally to you.

This is a personality tendency, not universal kindness. You still have boundaries and people you do not like.

+1 Charisma. An optional second tendency belongs in your Background.
Warm.traitNarrativeEffects: The character expresses care visibly and readily. They check on people, offer practical help and create comfortable social environments. Others tend to relax around them and share more than they intended. Their warmth is genuine but not limitless — they can be hurt by ingratitude or manipulation, and they sometimes overextend themselves caring for others at their own expense.

Decisive.name: Decisive
Decisive.description:
you are comfortable choosing a course of action and committing to it. When others debate, you tend to pick a direction and move. You would rather correct a wrong choice than waste time choosing.

This is a personality tendency, not infallibility. Quick decisions are not always right decisions.

+1 Presence. An optional second tendency belongs in your Background.
Decisive.traitNarrativeEffects: The character makes decisions quickly and sticks with them. They cut through indecision in groups, take initiative and accept the consequences of their choices. Others may follow their lead by default or resent being steamrolled. Their decisiveness is an asset in emergencies and a liability when the situation calls for deliberation and consensus.

Steady.name: Steady
Steady.description:
you prefer sustainable routines and consistent effort. Dramatic bursts and shortcuts do not appeal to you; you trust the process and show up every day.

This is a personality tendency, not rigidity. You can adapt when circumstances truly require it.

+1 Endurance. An optional second tendency belongs in your Background.
Steady.traitNarrativeEffects: The character values consistency. They maintain routines, honour schedules and produce reliable, predictable work. Others know what to expect from them, which builds trust in professional and personal relationships. They can struggle when forced into chaotic or rapidly changing environments, preferring to re-establish order as quickly as possible.

Precise.name: Precise
Precise.description:
you enjoy deliberate, accurate work. Measuring twice, aligning carefully, getting the details exactly right — you find satisfaction in work done properly, not just done quickly.

This is a personality tendency, not perfection. You still make mistakes.

+1 Agility. An optional second tendency belongs in your Background.
Precise.traitNarrativeEffects: The character values accuracy and quality. They take care with details, double-check their work and are uncomfortable with sloppy results even when speed is more important. They produce high-quality output but can be slow, and they notice errors in others' work that they may or may not mention. They are well-suited to tasks requiring fine motor control, measurement and careful assembly.

Forceful.name: Forceful
Forceful.description:
you prefer direct physical effort when it is the right tool for the job. You are straightforward, physically confident and not inclined to search for a clever workaround when strength and directness will solve the problem.

This is a personality tendency, not aggression. Forceful is not violent.

+1 Strength. An optional second tendency belongs in your Background.
Forceful.traitNarrativeEffects: The character defaults to direct, physical approaches. They push through obstacles rather than around them, speak plainly and act with visible physical confidence. Others may read this as reassuring strength or intimidating bluntness depending on context. They respect effort and dislike unnecessary complexity. Their directness is a personality trait, not a combat stance — they apply it to moving furniture as readily as to confrontation.
