Independence.name: Independence
Independence.description:
you want to build a life on your own terms. Whether that means financial freedom, personal autonomy or simply not answering to anyone, your choices are driven by the desire to stand on your own.

Motivation grants no mechanical bonus, compulsory quest or predetermined response. It is a guide for how your character approaches decisions.
Independence.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is motivated by self-determination. They resist obligations that feel imposed, prefer to choose their own work, and measure success by how much control they have over their own life. They may accept a job or alliance when it serves their goals but chafe when it becomes a cage. Present opportunities as choices, not mandates. When they feel trapped, they look for exits.

Belonging.name: Belonging
Belonging.description:
you want to find a community where you fit. This might be a crew, a neighbourhood, a guild or a family — any group where you are known, valued and missed when absent.

Motivation grants no mechanical bonus, compulsory quest or predetermined response. It is a guide for how your character approaches decisions.
Belonging.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is motivated by connection and community. They seek groups, value shared rituals and feel restless when isolated. They invest in relationships and notice when they are included or excluded. Present social opportunities and group dynamics as meaningful. When they find a community, they protect it; when they lose one, finding the next becomes urgent.

Mastery.name: Mastery
Mastery.description:
you want to become excellent at a chosen craft, discipline or skill. The work itself matters as much as the result. You practice, refine and push your limits because getting better is the point.

Motivation grants no mechanical bonus, compulsory quest or predetermined response. It is a guide for how your character approaches decisions.
Mastery.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is motivated by skill and craft. They respect expertise in others, seek out teachers and challenges, and measure progress against their own previous ability. They are drawn to workshops, training grounds and anyone who has mastered something they have not. Present skill-testing situations and mentorship opportunities. Stagnation frustrates them more than failure.

Discovery.name: Discovery
Discovery.description:
you want to understand something unfamiliar. New places, unknown phenomena, unanswered questions — the drive to learn pulls you forward even when staying put would be safer.

Motivation grants no mechanical bonus, compulsory quest or predetermined response. It is a guide for how your character approaches decisions.
Discovery.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is motivated by curiosity and understanding. They investigate anomalies, ask probing questions and are drawn to the unexplained. They value new information over comfort and will take risks to learn something no one else knows. Present mysteries, unexplored areas and unanswered questions as hooks. They lose interest once something is fully understood and look for the next unknown.

Recognition.name: Recognition
Recognition.description:
you want your work, effort or achievements to be noticed and acknowledged. Not fame for its own sake, but the validation that comes from knowing your contribution mattered.

Motivation grants no mechanical bonus, compulsory quest or predetermined response. It is a guide for how your character approaches decisions.
Recognition.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is motivated by acknowledgement. They want their efforts to be seen and valued — by peers, superiors or the public. They take pride in visible accomplishments and feel diminished when their work goes unnoticed. Present opportunities for reputation-building and public contribution. Being overlooked or having credit taken by others is a significant source of frustration.

Care for someone.name: Care for someone
Care for someone.description:
you want to improve the situation of a specific person you care about. A family member, a friend, a partner, a ward — someone whose wellbeing drives your choices more than your own.

Motivation grants no mechanical bonus, compulsory quest or predetermined response. It is a guide for how your character approaches decisions.
Care for someone.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is motivated by devotion to a specific person. Their decisions filter through how the outcome affects that individual. They will accept personal risk or sacrifice comfort to protect, support or help the person they care about. Present situations where that person's needs conflict with the character's own interests. The relationship does not need to be healthy or reciprocated to be powerful.

Fresh start.name: Fresh start
Fresh start.description:
you want to leave something behind and make room for a different future. Whatever happened before — a mistake, a loss, a dead end — you are here to begin again.

Motivation grants no mechanical bonus, compulsory quest or predetermined response. It is a guide for how your character approaches decisions.
Fresh start.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is motivated by reinvention. They avoid revisiting the past, seek new environments and new identities, and are drawn to opportunities that have no connection to who they used to be. Present forward-looking opportunities and moments where the past threatens to catch up. They may be evasive about their history and uncomfortable when someone recognises them from before.

Service.name: Service
Service.description:
you want to do useful work for a community. Not grand heroics, but the steady, necessary labour that keeps things running. You find purpose in contributing to something larger than yourself.

Motivation grants no mechanical bonus, compulsory quest or predetermined response. It is a guide for how your character approaches decisions.
Service.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is motivated by duty and contribution. They find satisfaction in work that helps others — whether that is maintaining infrastructure, feeding people, teaching or patrolling. They measure their worth by usefulness and feel lost without a role to fill. Present situations where practical help is needed. They volunteer before being asked and feel guilty when idle during a crisis.

Security.name: Security
Security.description:
you want to build a stable home and livelihood. A reliable income, a safe place to sleep, predictable routines — the things that let you plan for tomorrow without worrying about today.

Motivation grants no mechanical bonus, compulsory quest or predetermined response. It is a guide for how your character approaches decisions.
Security.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is motivated by stability. They value predictability, avoid unnecessary risk and invest in things that last. They build savings, maintain their home and choose reliable work over exciting work. Present threats to their stability as serious motivators. They resist adventures that jeopardise what they have built unless the stakes are high enough to justify the risk.

Prosperity.name: Prosperity
Prosperity.description:
you want to earn enough to pursue larger plans. Money, resources, influence — not as ends but as tools that open doors. You are building toward something that requires more than you currently have.

Motivation grants no mechanical bonus, compulsory quest or predetermined response. It is a guide for how your character approaches decisions.
Prosperity.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is motivated by accumulation toward a goal. They evaluate opportunities by return on investment, negotiate for better terms and keep track of their resources carefully. Their ambition is practical — they know what they want and are calculating the path to get there. Present profitable opportunities and resource-management decisions. They are willing to delay gratification for a larger payoff.

Repair a wrong.name: Repair a wrong
Repair a wrong.description:
you want to address a specific, supported harm. Something happened that should not have, and you intend to make it right — whether that means justice, restitution or prevention.

Motivation grants no mechanical bonus, compulsory quest or predetermined response. It is a guide for how your character approaches decisions.
Repair a wrong.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is motivated by justice for a specific wrong. They carry the harm with them and measure opportunities against whether they bring resolution closer. They may be patient or impatient about it, methodical or impulsive, but the wrong shapes their priorities. Present situations that echo the original harm or offer paths toward addressing it. They notice injustice in everyday life because they are primed to look for it.

Adventure.name: Adventure
Adventure.description:
you want worthwhile new experiences. Not recklessness for its own sake, but the genuine thrill of going somewhere you have not been, doing something you have not done and coming back with a story worth telling.

Motivation grants no mechanical bonus, compulsory quest or predetermined response. It is a guide for how your character approaches decisions.
Adventure.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is motivated by novelty and experience. They grow restless in routine, volunteer for the unknown assignment and value stories over savings. They are drawn to unfamiliar places, unusual people and situations where the outcome is uncertain. Present travel opportunities, strange encounters and moments of genuine risk. They accept danger as the price of an interesting life but are not suicidal — they want to survive to tell the tale.

Gravity and vectors.name: Gravity and vectors
Gravity and vectors.description:
You feel the pull of things — weight, direction, the invisible lines along which objects want to move. Your affinity lets you shift gravitational forces on yourself and objects you're engaged with, altering how heavy something feels, which way it falls, or how firmly you're planted.

Practiced technique: *Weighted Step* — alter downward pull on yourself to plant a stance or lighten a step.

Good for: physical combat, traversal, manual work, holding ground under pressure.
Gravity and vectors.traitNarrativeEffects: Gravity and vectors expression. The character perceives and adjusts gravitational pull and directional force on themselves and engaged objects. This is personal and tactile — shifting weight, redirecting a fall, planting against a push — not remote planetary-scale gravity control. Effort, stamina, and bodily limits apply. Two people with this expression still differ in temperament and precision. Practice grants Weighted Step (adjusting personal downward pull) and Affinity Control +10. No universal telekinesis, flight without support, or ability to crush objects at range.

Orbital momentum.name: Orbital momentum
Orbital momentum.description:
Moving objects have a natural arc, and you can feel it — then bend it. Your affinity lets you curve the path of objects already in motion around your position, guiding a thrown tool, redirecting a projectile, or sweeping debris out of the way.

Practiced technique: *Guided Arc* — curve the course of a moving loose object around you.

Good for: ranged combat, deflection, dynamic problem-solving in the field.
Orbital momentum.traitNarrativeEffects: Orbital momentum expression. The character curves the trajectory of objects already in motion near them. Motion must be established first — this does not create matter, launch objects from rest, or supply unlimited orbiting weapons. Effective range is personal proximity, not remote battlefield control. Effort, stamina, and bodily limits apply. Practice grants Guided Arc and Affinity Control +10. The expression reflects the individual — two orbital users redirect differently based on instinct and training.

Spatial anchoring.name: Spatial anchoring
Spatial anchoring.description:
You can hold things where they are. Your affinity stabilizes the position of objects you're in contact with, keeping them locked in place against ordinary disturbance — a door that won't open, a beam that won't fall, a tool that stays exactly where you set it.

Practiced technique: *Hold Point* — hold a contacted object at its position against ordinary force.

Good for: defense, engineering, rescue work, holding the line.
Spatial anchoring.traitNarrativeEffects: Spatial anchoring expression. The character stabilizes contacted objects against displacement. This is positional stabilization, not control over all space — load, engagement, and bodily effort matter. Heavier objects or stronger forces tax stamina faster. The anchor is maintained through sustained effort, not permanent. Practice grants Hold Point and Affinity Control +10. No remote anchoring, freezing time, or holding objects the character cannot physically engage.

Stellar light and radiance.name: Stellar light and radiance
Stellar light and radiance.description:
Your affinity channels focused light — luminous, directed, and forceful. You can project beams for illumination, signaling, or concentrated radiant force, drawing on the stellar energy that Starians carry internally.

Practiced technique: *Radiant Mark* — project a focused luminous mark onto a visible surface.

Good for: illumination, signaling, precision targeting, combat at range.
Stellar light and radiance.traitNarrativeEffects: Stellar light and radiance expression. The character projects focused light and radiant force. The force component is part of this individual's expression, not a universal bonus for every light affinity user. Output scales with effort and stamina; sustained brightness is taxing. Practice grants Radiant Mark and Affinity Control +10. No blinding immunity, unlimited range, or conversion of light into other energy forms.

Crimson energy and force.name: Crimson energy and force
Crimson energy and force.description:
Raw power runs through you — crimson-tinted personal energy that reinforces your physical actions. Strikes hit harder, charges carry more momentum, and your body channels force that goes beyond what muscle alone provides.

Practiced technique: *Crimson Drive* — commit personal crimson force through a deliberate strike or forward movement.

Good for: melee combat, physical confrontation, high-intensity situations.
Crimson energy and force.traitNarrativeEffects: Crimson energy and force expression. The character channels personal crimson-tinted energy through deliberate physical action. This reinforces chosen impacts and movements, not every action automatically. No legendary strength by default, energy projection at range without separate technique, or immunity to recoil. Practice grants Crimson Drive and Affinity Control +10. Effort, recovery, and bodily limits apply — a powerful strike still leaves the user spent if they overcommit.

Geo-volcanic expression.name: Geo-volcanic expression
Geo-volcanic expression.description:
Stone answers to you. Your affinity displaces and shapes workable rock — raising barriers, creating footholds, moving earth out of the way or into it. You work with what's underfoot, not from nothing.

Practiced technique: *Stone Rise* — raise a patch of loose or continuous stone into an obstruction or foothold.

Good for: fortification, terrain control, construction, rescue, combat in rocky environments.
Geo-volcanic expression.traitNarrativeEffects: Geo-volcanic expression. The character displaces and shapes contacted workable stone. This selects stone manipulation — magma, heat effects, and every other Tacitus-style ability are not bundled in. The character works with real geology: loose soil responds differently than bedrock, and volume demands effort. Practice grants Stone Rise and Affinity Control +10. No matter creation from nothing, remote manipulation of distant terrain, or instant fortress construction.

Cryothermal expression.name: Cryothermal expression
Cryothermal expression.description:
You draw heat away. Your affinity chills surfaces and objects through contact — cooling overheated equipment, freezing a wet surface solid, or making a material cold enough to become brittle.

Practiced technique: *Cold Contact* — draw heat from a contacted nonliving surface until it becomes meaningfully cold.

Good for: material work, preservation, environmental survival, disabling equipment, combat in close quarters.
Cryothermal expression.traitNarrativeEffects: Cryothermal expression. The character draws heat from contacted nonliving surfaces, reducing temperature through sustained effort. This is heat removal, not ice creation from nothing or instant remote organ freezing. The material must be contacted, and the rate of cooling depends on mass and starting temperature. Practice grants Cold Contact and Affinity Control +10. No universal cold immunity, creation of new water or ice from nothing, or freezing living tissue on contact without sustained focus.

Pyrothermal force.name: Pyrothermal force
Pyrothermal force.description:
Heat is yours to give. Your affinity applies concentrated warmth through contact — heating metal for forging, warming a surface, igniting prepared material, or pushing thermal force into a target.

Practiced technique: *Heat Palm* — apply deliberate heat to an exposed contacted target or workpiece.

Good for: metalwork, survival, field repair, cooking, combat at touch range.
Pyrothermal force.traitNarrativeEffects: Pyrothermal force expression. The character applies deliberate concentrated heat through contact. This is thermal addition, not fire control, smoke manipulation, or heat immunity. Uncontrolled material can ignite — the user must know what they're heating. Practice grants Heat Palm and Affinity Control +10. Output scales with effort; sustained heating of large or resistant material is taxing. No ranged fire projection without separate technique, or safe heating of unknown materials.

Air currents and pressure.name: Air currents and pressure
Air currents and pressure.description:
You move the air itself — driving currents, clearing sightlines, pushing loose objects, or creating a meaningful gust where you need one. Your affinity works with the air that's actually there.

Practiced technique: *Crosscurrent* — drive an air current to clear a sightline or push a loose object.

Good for: ventilation, visibility, ranged deflection, crowd situations, environmental hazards.
Air currents and pressure.traitNarrativeEffects: Air currents and pressure expression. The character drives actual air currents for clearing, pushing, and environmental control. Affected air must exist — no vacuum creation, weather sovereignty, or guaranteed stopping power against every target. Wind in enclosed spaces behaves differently than outdoors. Practice grants Crosscurrent and Affinity Control +10. Effort and stamina apply; sustained gale-force output depletes the user quickly.

Pressure shearing.name: Pressure shearing
Pressure shearing.description:
You apply focused cutting force — a wedge of concentrated pressure that separates material along a line. Not a blade in your hand, but a directed physical force that splits, shifts, and pries.

Practiced technique: *Pressure Wedge* — apply focused pressure to shift a loose obstruction from a chosen opening.

Good for: breaching, rescue, material work, clearing blocked passages, combat.
Pressure shearing.traitNarrativeEffects: Pressure shearing expression. The character applies focused pressure separation to shift and split material. This is a physical force application, not effortless cutting of every substance or intangibility. Harder materials and thicker sections demand more effort and precise control. Practice grants Pressure Wedge and Affinity Control +10. No tunneling through unlimited material, cutting without physical engagement, or splitting objects at a distance.

Ferromorphic control.name: Ferromorphic control
Ferromorphic control.description:
Metal responds to you. Your affinity draws loose metallic components into your reach, holds them in orientation, and lets you work with metal in ways that go beyond hand tools alone.

Practiced technique: *Gather Metal* — draw responsive loose components into reach or hold one in orientation.

Good for: engineering, repair, salvage, metalwork, combat with metal objects.
Ferromorphic control.traitNarrativeEffects: Ferromorphic control expression. The character draws and positions responsive loose metallic components through affinity. No universal metal control over all metals at any range, inaccessible implant manipulation, or automatic engineering knowledge. The metal must be loose and responsive — embedded, sealed, or shielded material resists. Practice grants Gather Metal and Affinity Control +10. Effort scales with mass and distance; precision work with multiple pieces simultaneously is demanding.

Electromagnetic perception and redirecti.name: Electromagnetic perception and redirection
Electromagnetic perception and redirecti.description:
You sense the flow of current and field. Your affinity perceives electromagnetic fields and exposed current paths, letting you read charged environments, detect active power systems, and redirect accessible currents.

Practiced technique: *Current Read* — sense a change in an engaged electromagnetic field or current path.

Good for: technical work, diagnostics, sabotage, navigation near powered systems, hazard detection.
Electromagnetic perception and redirecti.traitNarrativeEffects: Electromagnetic perception and redirection expression. The character senses and redirects engaged electromagnetic fields and current paths. This contains sensing and redirection, not data access, hacking, unlimited power generation, or immunity to electrical harm. The field or current must be accessible and engaged. Practice grants Current Read and Affinity Control +10. Complex or shielded systems are harder to read, and high-energy redirection carries personal risk.

Density anchoring.name: Density anchoring
Density anchoring.description:
You become unmovable. Your affinity sets your body into a dense, resistant state that resists being pushed, thrown, or knocked aside — you plant and you hold.

Practiced technique: *Rooted Stance* — set into a dense, resistant stance against being moved.

Good for: holding positions, melee combat, crowd control, heavy labor, standing ground.
Density anchoring.traitNarrativeEffects: Density anchoring expression. The character sets their body into a dense, resistant stance through affinity. This is not Hadavar's legendary immovability — it's a personal defensive expression with real limits. Supporting ground still carries the load, and the stance must be deliberate. Practice grants Rooted Stance and Affinity Control +10. No automatic armor aura, unmovable object under any force, or passive always-on density.

Momentum softening.name: Momentum softening
Momentum softening.description:
You take the sting out of impact. Your affinity reduces the momentum of objects during deliberate physical engagement — catching something hard without injury, landing a fall gently, or receiving a blow that should have hurt more.

Practiced technique: *Gentle Catch* — reduce momentum of an object during deliberate engagement.

Good for: rescue, acrobatics, dangerous catches, fall survival, combat defense.
Momentum softening.traitNarrativeEffects: Momentum softening expression. The character reduces impact momentum during deliberate physical engagement. This requires conscious engagement — the character must be aware of and actively engaging the incoming force. No remote universal cancellation of all motion, and an overwhelming impact can exceed the character's capacity. Practice grants Gentle Catch and Affinity Control +10. Softening demand scales with the momentum being absorbed; a falling vehicle is harder than a thrown stone.

Impact absorption.name: Impact absorption
Impact absorption.description:
You take hits differently. Your affinity absorbs a selected impact through your body's expression, letting you brace against blows that would flatten someone else. The force enters you and disperses, rather than breaking you.

Practiced technique: *Absorbing Brace* — take a selected impact into your absorption expression while maintaining stance.

Good for: frontline combat, bodyguard work, hazardous environments, crash survival.
Impact absorption.traitNarrativeEffects: Impact absorption expression. The character takes selected impacts into their absorption expression during a deliberate stance. Absorption does not mean stored energy, later discharge, healing, or total immunity. The force is dispersed, not recycled. Injury and fatigue still accumulate from repeated or overwhelming impacts. Practice grants Absorbing Brace and Affinity Control +10. The character must be braced and aware — surprise impacts bypass the expression.

Kinetic reinforcement and release.name: Kinetic reinforcement and release
Kinetic reinforcement and release.description:
Your movements carry more force than they should. Your affinity reinforces a chosen motion and releases extra kinetic energy at the point of contact — a punch that hits like a ram, a throw that covers impossible distance.

Practiced technique: *Reinforced Contact* — reinforce a chosen movement and release kinetic energy through contact.

Good for: melee combat, heavy labor, athletics, breaching, sports.
Kinetic reinforcement and release.traitNarrativeEffects: Kinetic reinforcement and release expression. The character reinforces deliberate movement and releases extra kinetic force at contact. This is committed force through specific chosen actions, not passive superhuman strength at all times. No automatic impact absorption, indefinite stored charge, or borrowed Genesis powers. Force output and recovery scale with effort. Practice grants Reinforced Contact and Affinity Control +10.

Kinetic barriers.name: Kinetic barriers
Kinetic barriers.description:
You can raise a wall of force. Your affinity projects a personal barrier across a selected approach — blocking a doorway, deflecting a strike, or shielding against debris. The barrier is yours and responds to your focus.

Practiced technique: *Guard Face* — raise a force-bearing barrier across a selected approach.

Good for: defense, protection, blocking access, combat shielding, rescue.
Kinetic barriers.traitNarrativeEffects: Kinetic barriers expression. The character raises a personal force-bearing barrier across selected approaches. The barrier shape belongs to this individual expression, not every energy user. No universal immunity, automatic reactive shielding, or barriers the character is not actively maintaining. Practice grants Guard Face and Affinity Control +10. Multiple or larger barriers demand proportionally more effort and concentration.

Vector locking.name: Vector locking
Vector locking.description:
You can arrest movement — briefly freeze a specific motion in place, whether your own step or an object's fall. Your affinity targets chosen vectors, locking them for a controlled moment.

Practiced technique: *Arrest Touch* — briefly arrest a chosen movement of yourself or an object under contact.

Good for: precision work, acrobatics, combat timing, catching falls.
Vector locking.traitNarrativeEffects: Vector locking expression. The character briefly arrests specified movement through contact. This affects targeted motion, not time itself, and not all surrounding forces or inaccessible targets. Duration is brief and sustained locking demands increasing effort. Practice grants Arrest Touch and Affinity Control +10. No unlimited restraint, time manipulation, or locking objects beyond physical reach.

Spatial line and route perception.name: Spatial line and route perception
Spatial line and route perception.description:
You see the shortest path. Your affinity perceives efficient movement lines through physical spaces — the clean route through a crowd, the angle that clears an obstacle, the step that avoids the hazard.

Practiced technique: *Clear Line* — perceive an efficient movement path through a visible arrangement.

Good for: navigation, pursuit, evasion, tactical movement, exploration.
Spatial line and route perception.traitNarrativeEffects: Spatial line and route perception expression. The character perceives efficient movement paths through visible arrangements. This is spatial awareness enhanced by affinity, not teleportation, future sight, or flawless execution. Physical capability, available information, and real obstacles still matter — perceiving a line and being able to take it are different things. Practice grants Clear Line and Affinity Control +10. Two spatial perceivers read different lines through the same space.

Vibration and structural sensing.name: Vibration and structural sensing
Vibration and structural sensing.description:
You feel what the ground is saying. Your affinity senses vibrations through contacted solid surfaces — footsteps through a floor, stress in a wall, movement beyond a door. You listen through contact.

Practiced technique: *Surface Listen* — sense meaningful vibration through a contacted solid support.

Good for: sentry duty, structural assessment, search and rescue, ambush awareness, tracking.
Vibration and structural sensing.traitNarrativeEffects: Vibration and structural sensing expression. The character senses meaningful vibrations through contacted solid surfaces. No automatic identification, intent reading, hidden images, or exact diagnosis. Disconnected or insulating material blocks useful signal. Practice grants Surface Listen and Affinity Control +10. Range and clarity depend on the medium — dense stone carries further than loose fill.

Machine-state awareness.name: Machine-state awareness
Machine-state awareness.description:
You can feel what a machine is doing. Your affinity perceives the operational state of engaged compatible machines — whether an engine is stressed, which component is failing, or when a system is about to overheat.

Practiced technique: *State Glimpse* — perceive a supported operational state of an engaged compatible machine.

Good for: maintenance, piloting, diagnostics, engineering, technical combat.
Machine-state awareness.traitNarrativeEffects: Machine-state awareness expression. The character perceives operational states of engaged compatible machines through affinity. This selects awareness, not remote command, authorization bypass, or universal compatibility. Unfamiliar or incompatible technology may give no useful reading. Practice grants State Glimpse and Affinity Control +10. No secret data extraction, automatic repair, or control over machines — only perception of their current state.

Tactile interface adaptation.name: Tactile interface adaptation
Tactile interface adaptation.description:
Technology responds better in your hands. Your affinity develops smoother response from compatible interfaces through deliberate use — controls become more intuitive, machines run more cleanly, and unfamiliar systems yield faster.

Practiced technique: *Responsive Touch* — develop smoother response from a compatible interface through use.

Good for: piloting, systems operation, unfamiliar tech, combat systems, repair.
Tactile interface adaptation.traitNarrativeEffects: Tactile interface adaptation expression. The character develops improved interface response through deliberate tactile engagement. No new machine function, security bypass, autonomous mastery, or compatibility from nothing. The interface must be compatible and the improvement builds through actual use, not instant command. Practice grants Responsive Touch and Affinity Control +10. Heavily encrypted, damaged, or deliberately incompatible systems still resist.

Material authenticity and trace.name: Material authenticity and trace
Material authenticity and trace.description:
You can feel whether something is what it claims to be. Your affinity senses material properties through contact — detecting forgeries, identifying composition, or tracing where something has been by what it carries.

Practiced technique: *Material Impression* — sense an authenticity-related property through contact.

Good for: investigation, trade, quality control, forgery detection, archaeology.
Material authenticity and trace.traitNarrativeEffects: Material authenticity and trace expression. The character senses actual material properties and authenticity through contact. This is a focused forensic sense, not complete provenance, ownership proof, guilt detection, or exact historical replay. The impression is limited to what this individual's expression supports — each user has different sensitivities. Practice grants Material Impression and Affinity Control +10. No identification of unknown substances without reference experience.

Material stress and integrity.name: Material stress and integrity
Material stress and integrity.description:
You can feel when something is about to break. Your affinity perceives stress within materials under contact — the hairline fracture in a support beam, the fatigue in a cable, the weak point in a structure.

Practiced technique: *Stress Touch* — perceive stress within a compatible material under contact.

Good for: structural inspection, engineering, demolition, rescue, maintenance.
Material stress and integrity.traitNarrativeEffects: Material stress and integrity expression. The character perceives internal stress in contacted compatible materials. Perception does not strengthen material, grant universal engineering knowledge, or guarantee a safe structure. The character senses what's there — interpreting it correctly depends on experience and training. Practice grants Stress Touch and Affinity Control +10. Complex composite materials or unfamiliar substances are harder to read accurately.

Joining and structural stabilization.name: Joining and structural stabilization
Joining and structural stabilization.description:
You hold things together. Your affinity stabilizes joints and connections — keeping a weld steady while it sets, holding a splint in place, or reinforcing a join that would otherwise fail under load.

Practiced technique: *Steady Join* — hold an engaged joint stable while ordinary joining work proceeds.

Good for: construction, repair, field surgery, structural rescue, engineering.
Joining and structural stabilization.traitNarrativeEffects: Joining and structural stabilization expression. The character holds engaged joints in stable intended relationships through affinity. This assists and stabilizes real joining work, not permanent unbreakability or material creation. Supported joints still have load limits and material constraints. Practice grants Steady Join and Affinity Control +10. Sustained stabilization of heavy or dynamic loads is physically demanding.

Thermal mapping and retention.name: Thermal mapping and retention
Thermal mapping and retention.description:
You hold warmth where it belongs. Your affinity maintains existing heat in objects you're touching — keeping a cooling engine at working temperature, a meal warm on a long march, or a tool at its useful heat.

Practiced technique: *Warm Hold* — maintain existing heat in a contacted nonliving object.

Good for: field maintenance, survival, material work, long operations, cooking.
Thermal mapping and retention.traitNarrativeEffects: Thermal mapping and retention expression. The character maintains existing useful heat in contacted compatible nonliving objects. This selects retention — not adding heat, cooling, or diagnostic thermal imaging. The character preserves what's already there, not raising temperature or creating warmth from nothing. Practice grants Warm Hold and Affinity Control +10. Sustained retention of heat in large objects or extreme conditions demands real effort.

Light composition and imprint.name: Light composition and imprint
Light composition and imprint.description:
You shape light deliberately — forming visible patterns, marks, or figures from your own output. Not illusions, but real, controlled light shaped for communication, signaling, or guidance.

Practiced technique: *Light Figure* — form a deliberate visible light pattern for communication or guidance.

Good for: signaling, navigation marking, communication, art, tactical coordination.
Light composition and imprint.traitNarrativeEffects: Light composition and imprint expression. The character forms deliberate visible light patterns through their expression. This selects composition — treated-surface recording requires a separately supported imprint capability. No hard-light matter creation, illusions that deceive, or offensive light weapons without separate technique. Practice grants Light Figure and Affinity Control +10. Output brightness and complexity scale with effort.

Sound separation and absorption.name: Sound separation and absorption
Sound separation and absorption.description:
You manage sound. Your affinity absorbs noise in a selected local space — muffling a conversation, silencing your footsteps, or creating a pocket of quiet in chaos.

Practiced technique: *Quiet Patch* — absorb sound in a selected engaged local space.

Good for: stealth, communication, concentration, eavesdropping prevention, ambush.
Sound separation and absorption.traitNarrativeEffects: Sound separation and absorption expression. The character absorbs sound within selected engaged local spaces. No invisibility, deletion of recordings, immunity to vibration, or control of thoughts. This is a specific sound-management expression — two sound users may differ in range, selectivity, and suppression depth. Practice grants Quiet Patch and Affinity Control +10. Larger spaces or louder sources demand more sustained effort.

Vocal resonance.name: Vocal resonance
Vocal resonance.description:
Your voice carries. Your affinity projects your actual voice with clarity and reach through environments that would normally drown it out — a command across a battlefield, a call through a storm, a word heard in a crowd.

Practiced technique: *Carried Voice* — make your voice carry intelligibly through a distracting environment.

Good for: leadership, command, performance, search and rescue, crowd situations.
Vocal resonance.traitNarrativeEffects: Vocal resonance expression. The character projects their actual voice with enhanced clarity and reach through affinity. No forced obedience, automatic emotional calming, telepathy, or proof that a listener understood or complied. The voice carries — what people do with it is still their choice. Practice grants Carried Voice and Affinity Control +10. Sustained projection is physically taxing, like shouting but channeled through affinity rather than lungs alone.

Emotional perception and regulation.name: Emotional perception and regulation
Emotional perception and regulation.description:
You sense how people feel. Your affinity perceives emotional strain in those nearby — stress, fear, calm, deception. Not mind-reading, but a genuine sense of emotional state that goes beyond body language.

Practiced technique: *Stress Impression* — perceive emotional strain available to your bounded sensing.

Good for: negotiation, counseling, interrogation, social situations, medical triage.
Emotional perception and regulation.traitNarrativeEffects: Emotional perception and regulation expression. The character perceives emotional states through a bounded affinity sense. This selects perception — it grants no thought access, forced regulation, or clinical diagnosis. The character senses what they sense; interpreting it correctly takes experience. Practice grants Stress Impression and Affinity Control +10. Strong emotions are clearer than subtle ones; deliberate concealment or distance reduces clarity.

Object impressions and residue.name: Object impressions and residue
Object impressions and residue.description:
Objects remember what happened to them — and you can feel it. Your affinity senses emotional impressions left on objects through careful contact, echoes of who held them and what they felt.

Practiced technique: *Held Impression* — sense a supported emotional impression left on an object through contact.

Good for: investigation, archaeology, lost-and-found, emotional forensics, history.
Object impressions and residue.traitNarrativeEffects: Object impressions and residue expression. The character senses emotional impressions left on objects through careful contact. No precise facts, historical recording, named culprits, testimony replacement, or memory theft. Impressions are emotional echoes, not recordings — they convey feeling, not events. Practice grants Held Impression and Affinity Control +10. Older or fainter impressions require more concentration; heavily handled objects carry muddled layers.

Biological field and recovery support.name: Biological field and recovery support
Biological field and recovery support.description:
Your touch helps people heal. Your affinity supports biological recovery in compatible injuries under careful contact — accelerating natural repair, stabilizing a wound, or supporting a body through trauma.

Practiced technique: *Recovery Contact* — apply regenerative support to a known compatible injury under deliberate contact.

Good for: field medicine, trauma care, long-term recovery, veterinary work, rescue.
Biological field and recovery support.traitNarrativeEffects: Biological field and recovery support expression. The character supports biological regeneration through deliberate contact with compatible injuries. This does not automatically add diagnostic sensing — the character must know what they're treating. Incompatible species biology, unknown injuries, or severed tissue beyond regeneration range are genuine limits. Practice grants Recovery Contact and Affinity Control +10. Sustained recovery support is physically draining; triage matters.

Neural stress sensitivity.name: Neural stress sensitivity
Neural stress sensitivity.description:
You sense the weight on someone's mind. Your affinity perceives neural strain during close interactions — exhaustion, cognitive overload, deception under pressure, or the effort of concealment.

Practiced technique: *Strain Sense* — perceive neural strain during an actual close interaction.

Good for: interrogation, medical assessment, counseling, security screening, crisis management.
Neural stress sensitivity.traitNarrativeEffects: Neural stress sensitivity expression. The character perceives neural strain through their bounded expression during close interaction. No mind reading, memory editing, mental domination, or access to private thoughts. This senses strain — not content. A person under pressure reads clearly; a relaxed person gives little. Practice grants Strain Sense and Affinity Control +10. Distance, shielding, or the subject's own composure can reduce clarity.

Cognitive partitioning and conceptual li.name: Cognitive partitioning and conceptual links
Cognitive partitioning and conceptual li.description:
Your mind runs parallel tracks. Your affinity lets you maintain a secondary line of thought while performing a primary task — monitoring a conversation while solving a problem, or tracking two separate timelines at once.

Practiced technique: *Held Thread* — maintain one secondary thought line while performing a familiar primary task.

Good for: multitasking, analysis, surveillance, academic work, complex planning.
Cognitive partitioning and conceptual li.traitNarrativeEffects: Cognitive partitioning and conceptual links expression. The character maintains parallel thought lines through affinity-supported mental structure. This creates no new knowledge, infallibility, perfect recall, or automatic comprehension. The secondary thread runs alongside the primary, not independently — it still draws on the same person's knowledge and capacity. Practice grants Held Thread and Affinity Control +10. Sustained partitioning under stress or fatigue becomes harder.

Pattern recognition and recall.name: Pattern recognition and recall
Pattern recognition and recall.description:
You notice what repeats. Your affinity highlights recurring patterns in information you observe — a rhythm in data, a habit in behavior, a structure in seemingly random events.

Practiced technique: *Pattern Notice* — recognize a supported recurring relationship in observed information.

Good for: analysis, investigation, code-breaking, behavioral prediction, research.
Pattern recognition and recall.traitNarrativeEffects: Pattern recognition and recall expression. The character recognizes recurring relationships in directly observed information through affinity. No foresight, perfect memory, knowledge of hidden facts, or unrelated psychic phenomena. The character notices patterns — connecting them to meaning requires actual reasoning and context. Practice grants Pattern Notice and Affinity Control +10. Novel or deliberately randomized data resists pattern extraction.

Spatial concealment and shadowed present.name: Spatial concealment and shadowed presentation
Spatial concealment and shadowed present.description:
You bend how you're seen. Your affinity softens your visible outline against your surroundings, blending your presence into shadow, clutter, or visual noise — not invisibility, but a persistent knack for going unnoticed.

Practiced technique: *Softened Outline* — soften your visible outline against suitable surroundings.

Good for: stealth, surveillance, evasion, undercover work, quiet movement.
Spatial concealment and shadowed present.traitNarrativeEffects: Spatial concealment and shadowed presentation expression. The character softens their visual presence against suitable surroundings. This is a distinct concealment expression, not true invisibility or intangibility. Bright light, open ground, or alert observers reduce effectiveness. Practice grants Softened Outline and Affinity Control +10. This is not Nina's unique shadow glass — each concealment user has their own signature limitations and tells.

Aether Mantle.name: Aether Mantle
Aether Mantle.description:
You wrap yourself in living protection. Aether Mantle extends your core energy into a responsive shield around you — a luminous, shifting layer that meets incoming threats while you remain free to act. It's not armor; it's an extension of you, drawn from your aether core.

Practiced technique: *Living Guard* — extend core energy into a responsive protective mantle.

An Elyri defensive practice: powerful, personal, and bounded by your core stability and effort.
Aether Mantle.traitNarrativeEffects: Aether Mantle embodiment. The Elyri extends organized core energy into a responsive protective mantle that intercepts incoming threats. The protection is linked to the user's living field and core stability — dividing protection increases core demand. No universal immunity, Starian-biology effects, or automatic core repair. Practice grants Living Guard and Embodiment +10. Nexara naturally sustains Elyri, so no compulsory recharge pack here, but core stability and effort still matter. This is the named starting foundation; advanced mantle techniques are separate.

Radiant Lance.name: Radiant Lance
Radiant Lance.description:
You concentrate your embodied energy into a single devastating projection — a directed beam of Elyri power, greater than any learned spell, paid for in core stability rather than vitality.

Practiced technique: *Coherent Lance* — project a directed, substantial emission of embodied energy against a chosen target.

An Elyri offensive practice: high output, real consequences. Sustained or divided emission taxes your core.
Radiant Lance.traitNarrativeEffects: Radiant Lance embodiment. The Elyri projects directed, substantial coherent energy against a chosen exposed target. Greater output than traditional learned-magic attack workings, but not unlimited penetration or range. Divided or sustained output taxes core stability with real collateral danger. Practice grants Coherent Lance and Embodiment +10. Nexara sustains Elyri naturally, but exertion, recovery, and core-stability limits are real. This is the named starting foundation; advanced techniques are separate.

Fieldborne Flight.name: Fieldborne Flight
Fieldborne Flight.description:
You fly — not through a spell or a machine, but through your own body's organized magical current. Fieldborne Flight is trained aerial movement sustained by your embodiment: takeoff, directed flight, and controlled landing, all from your own living energy.

Practiced technique: *Embodied Flight* — sustain takeoff, aerial movement, and controlled landing through your body's current.

An Elyri mobility practice: freedom of movement powered by your core.
Fieldborne Flight.traitNarrativeEffects: Fieldborne Flight embodiment. The Elyri sustains takeoff, directed aerial movement, and controlled landing through organized personal magical current. This is trained embodiment, not a lift charm or automatic Starian flight — different biological basis, different feel. Real load, field conditions, and core strain apply; no vacuum survival, endless flight, or interstellar speed. Practice grants Embodied Flight and Embodiment +10. Nexara sustains Elyri naturally, but physical exertion and core limits are real.

Resonant Architecture.name: Resonant Architecture
Resonant Architecture.description:
You build with energy. Resonant Architecture lets you shape and sustain substantial structures from your own organized living field — platforms, walls, shelters, protective barriers. Not permanent construction, but real, force-bearing structures as long as you maintain them.

Practiced technique: *Living Platform* — shape and sustain a substantial force-bearing platform or structure.

An Elyri engineering practice: build what you need from what you are.
Resonant Architecture.traitNarrativeEffects: Resonant Architecture embodiment. The Elyri shapes and sustains substantial force-bearing structures through their organized living field. Not illumination, permanent matter creation, or instant city building. Connected load and dynamic changes demand core stability and field support; failures can compromise real users. Practice grants Living Platform and Embodiment +10. Nexara sustains Elyri naturally, but structural scale and duration tax core resources. This is the starting foundation; advanced architectural techniques are separate.

Living Restoration.name: Living Restoration
Living Restoration.description:
Your energy heals. Living Restoration channels your core's power into repairing damaged living structures — closing wounds, stabilizing injuries, supporting biological recovery at a level beyond what learned healing magic achieves.

Practiced technique: *Restorative Contact* — support substantial repair of a compatible injury under clinical conditions.

An Elyri medical practice: the healer must understand what they're treating. Greater than magic, but not resurrection.
Living Restoration.traitNarrativeEffects: Living Restoration embodiment. The Elyri channels core-mediated shaping to support substantial repair of compatible, understood living structures. Greater restoration than ordinary learned healing, but the actual injury, species compatibility, and the practitioner's medical knowledge must be specified. No blanket regeneration, confirmed-death reversal, guaranteed core-fracture cure, or replacement of a person. Practice grants Restorative Contact and Embodiment +10. The healer's understanding of the patient's biology matters as much as their power.

Harmonic Domain.name: Harmonic Domain
Harmonic Domain.description:
You reshape the space around you. Harmonic Domain organizes a surrounding active field through sustained personal resonance — changing conditions within your domain to support your other embodied work. The space becomes yours, shaped by your presence.

Practiced technique: *Living Field* — organize a substantial surrounding active field through sustained resonance.

An Elyri environmental practice: your presence changes the rules of the space you occupy.
Harmonic Domain.traitNarrativeEffects: Harmonic Domain embodiment. The Elyri organizes a substantial surrounding active field through sustained personal resonance, shaping conditions for embodied work. Not sovereignty, mind control, infinite external fuel, altered physical law, or automatic suppression of other powers. Domain conditions do not supply unlearned techniques or erase other practitioners' agency. Practice grants Living Field and Embodiment +10. Maintaining a domain is sustained effort — larger areas and stronger shaping demand more core resources.

Resonance Severance.name: Resonance Severance
Resonance Severance.description:
You can break what others build. Resonance Severance lets you engage and disrupt external magical workings — unraveling a ward, collapsing a barrier, or interfering with sustained enchantments through precise embodied counter-resonance.

Practiced technique: *Pattern Break* — engage an exposed external magical working and disrupt its organization.

An Elyri disruption practice: powerful interference with magical constructs, not a universal cancel button.
Resonance Severance.traitNarrativeEffects: Resonance Severance embodiment. The Elyri engages exposed external magical workings and disrupts their organization with precise embodied interference. Greater embodied interference than learned dispelling, but not an automatic answer to every spell. No erasure of biological affinity, machine shutdown by fiat, or permission to ignore stored-energy hazards. Practice grants Pattern Break and Embodiment +10. The working must be exposed and accessible; heavily fortified or alien constructs resist.

Concordant Surge.name: Concordant Surge
Concordant Surge.description:
You harmonize with another Elyri. Concordant Surge aligns your active field with a willing, trained partner — two Elyri resonating together to support a shared expression greater than either could sustain alone.

Practiced technique: *Willing Concord* — align active fields with a willing trained Elyri to support a shared expression.

An Elyri cooperative practice: true partnership, not a power boost. Both participants must bring real skill.
Concordant Surge.traitNarrativeEffects: Concordant Surge embodiment. Two willing trained Elyri align their active fields to support one explicitly chosen shared expression. Each participant needs the actual technique and system access appropriate to their contribution — both bring real prerequisites. No free partner, merged selves, shared memories, imposed obedience, telepathy, or limitless sum of power. Practice grants Willing Concord and Embodiment +10. Synchronization demands mutual trust and training; a clumsy alignment destabilizes both participants.
